# Suspension or Delisting

## Suspensi atau Delisting

The Company experienced a temporary trading suspension imposed by the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) on 27 October 2025 pursuant to IDX Letter No. Peng-SPT-00341/BEI.WAS/102-5 dated 24 October 2025. The suspension was implemented in the Regular Market and Cash Market as a cooling down measure following a significant cumulative increase in the Company's share price in the market. Furthermore, on October 27, 2025 the IDX also requested the Company to conduct an Incidental Public Expose in connection with the increase in the Company's cumulative share price as referred to in the previous paragraph, as well as the Company's current financial performance and business conditions. The Company conducted the Incidental Public Expose on November 10, 2025.

Trading of the Company's shares resumed on 14 November 2025 following the convention of the Incidental Public Expose. However, due to the temporary suspension of trading of the Company's shares from October 27 to November 13, the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) has added the Company to the Special Monitoring List which is effective from November 14, 2025 through Exchange Announcement No. Peng-PK-00094/BEI.PLP/11-2025 dated November 13, 2025. While on the Special Monitoring List, the Company's shares are traded using an auction mechanism. Furthermore, based on Exchange Announcement No. Peng-CK-00101/BEI.PLP/11-2025 dated November 24, 2025 regarding the Revocation of Equity Securities from Special Monitoring, the Company's shares have been revoked by the IDX from the Special Monitoring List effective from November 25, 2025.

Perseroan mengalami penghentian sementara perdagangan saham oleh Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) pada tanggal 27 Oktober 2025 berdasarkan Surat BEI Nomor Peng-SPT-00341/BEI.WAS/102-5 tertanggal 24 Oktober 2025. Penghentian sementara tersebut dilakukan di Pasar Reguler dan Pasar Tunai dalam rangka cooling down sehubungan dengan terjadinya peningkatan harga kumulatif saham Perseroan secara signifikan di pasar. Selain itu, pada tanggal 27 Oktober 2025 BEI juga meminta Perseroan untuk melaksanakan Paparan Publik Insidentil (Incidental Public Expose) sehubungan dengan peningkatan harga kumulatif saham Perseroan sebagaimana dimaksud serta menyampaikan informasi mengenai kinerja keuangan dan kondisi bisnis terkini Perseroan. Perseroan telah melaksanakan Paparan Publik Insidentil tersebut pada tanggal 10 November 2025.

Perdagangan saham Perseroan kembali dibuka pada tanggal 14 November 2025 setelah dilaksanakannya Paparan Publik Insidentil tersebut. Namun dikarenakan adanya penghentian sementara perdagangan saham Perseroan dari tanggal 27 Oktober hingga 13 November, maka Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) telah menambahkan Perseroan ke dalam Daftar Pemantauan Khusus yang berlaku efektif sejak tanggal 14 November 2025 melalui Pengumuman Bursa No. Peng-PK-00094/BEI.PLP/11-2025 tertanggal 13 November 2025. Selama berada dalam Daftar Pemantauan Khusus tersebut, saham Perseroan diperdagangkan dengan mekanisme auction. Selanjutnya, berdasarkan Pengumuman Bursa No. Peng-CK-00101/BEI.PLP/11-2025 tertanggal 24 November 2025 mengenai Pencabutan Efek Bersifat Ekuitas dari Pemantauan Khusus, saham Perseroan telah dicabut oleh BEI dari Daftar Pemantauan Khusus efektif sejak tanggal 25 November 2025.

Apart from the aforementioned temporary suspension, there were no other temporary trading suspensions or delisting actions imposed on the Company's shares during the 2025 Financial Year.

Selain penghentian sementara tersebut di atas, tidak terdapat tindakan penghentian sementara perdagangan saham lainnya atau pembatalan pencatatan saham (delisting) atas saham Perseroan sepanjang Tahun Buku 2025.

# Listing Board Movement

The transfer is effective as of May 31, 2024. As of the date of publication of this Annual Report, there have been no further announcements or updates from the IDX regarding further changes to the Company's share listing board. Pada saat ini, saham Perseroan tercatat dalam Papan Pengembangan.

# Dear Fellow Shareholders,

# Kepada Para Pemegang Saham yang Terhormat,

"For 80 years, we have earned the trust of generations by consistently delivering high-quality medicines and health supplements"

"Selama 80 tahun, kami telah membangun kepercayaan lintas generasi dengan secara konsisten menyediakan obat-obatan dan suplemen kesehatan berkualitas tinggi."

When the business was founded in 1946 by the late Mr. Tan Tjhoen Lim, it was built on a strong commitment to providing equitable access to quality healthcare in Indonesia. Eighty (80) years later, PT Soho Global Health, Tbk and its subsidiaries ("SOHO Group") continue to honor that commitment. What began as a small factory in a modest garage has now expanded into a network of state-of-the-art pharmaceutical manufacturing and healthcare distribution units across the archipelago. Today, we are among the top 15 leading pharmaceutical companies in Indonesia and rank $2^{\text{nd}}$ in the Free Sales (OTC) market. Everything we do is centered around our Purpose — to hold the care of human life as our highest priority and thereby glorify God.

There has never been a more exciting time for SOHO Group, as we have stepped into the $80^{\text{th}}$ year of our operations in 2026. For 80 years, we have earned the trust of generations by consistently delivering high-quality medicines and health supplements. It is a testament of our commitment to preventing diseases and promoting wellness of millions of people in Indonesia.

That long journey is not only made by strong financial performance. It is made by our culture and how our values are embedded in the purpose of holding the care of human life as our highest priority and thereby glorify God. We remain aware of and humbled by our responsibility to shareholders, patients, customers, and society. And we always strive to deliver results and enhance our contribution to the patients/customers we serve and the society we are privileged to be a part of.

The success of SOHO Group is built on being true to our purpose and living our values to deliver for people, society, and the planet. Our success is built on relentlessly pushing the boundaries to be a healthcare leader and the preeminent provider of innovative natural pharmaceutical products, as reflected in our vision statement.

# 2025 in review: Resilient growth

Kajian Kinerja 2025: Pertumbuhan yang Tangguh

In 2025, SOHO Group closed the year with a Net Income For the Year of IDR 600.32 billion from IDR 462.65 billion in 2024, a $29.8\%$ increase compared to a year earlier.

Ketika Perusahaan didirikan pada tahun 1946 oleh mendinga Bapak Tan Tjhoen Lim, fondasinya dibangun di atas komitmen kuat untuk menyediakan akses yang merata terhadap layanan kesehatan berkualitas di Indonesia. Delapan puluh (80) tahun kemudian, PT Soho Global Health, Tbk dan anak perusahaannya ("SOHO Grup") terus menghormati dan meneruskan komitmen tersebut. Yang awalnya dimulai dari sebuah pabrik kecil di garasi sederhana, kini telah berkembang menjadi jaringan unit manufaktur farmasi dan distribusi layanan kesehatan berteknologi tinggi yang tersebar di seluruh nusantara. Saat ini, kami memimpin sebagai top 15 perusahaan kesehatan terkemuka di Indonesia dan menempati peringkat ke-2 di pasar Free Sales (OTC). Seluruh kegiatan kami berpusat pada Tujuan kami — menjunjung kepedulian terhadap kehidupan manusia sebagai prioritas kami yang tertinggi untuk memuliakan Tuhan yang Maha Esa.

Tidak pernah ada momen yang lebih menggembirakan bagi SOHO Grup selain saat ini, ketika kami memasuki tahun ke-80 operasional kami pada tahun 2026. Selama 80 tahun, kami telah meraih kepercayaan lintas generasi melalui konsistensi dalam menghadirkan obat-obatan dan suplemen kesehatan berkualitas tinggi. Hal ini menjadi bukti nyata dari komitmen kami dalam mendukung pencegahan penyakit dan mendorong terciptanya kehidupan yang lebih sehat bagi jutaan masyarakat Indonesia.

Perjalanan panjang tersebut tidak semata ditentukan oleh kinerja keuangan yang kuat. Perjalanan itu dibentuk oleh budaya perusahaan kami dan bagaimana nilai-nilai kami tertanam dalam Tujuan kami menjunjung kepedulian terhadap kehidupan manusia sebagai prioritas kami yang tertinggi untuk memuliakan Tuhan yang Maha Esa. # Chronology of Shares Listing

## Kronologi Pencatatan Saham

**Year 2020**
Tahun 2020

The Company has submitted a Registration Statement in connection with the Public Offering to the Financial Services Authority under Number 396/SGH-OJK/VII/2020 dated June 25, 2020 regarding the Cover Letter for the Registration Statement in the context of the Company's Initial Public Offering and the latest amendments and/or additional information had been submitted through Letter Number 529/SGH-OJK/VIII/2020 dated August 28, 2020 regarding the Cover Letter for Changes and/or Additional Documents and/or Information on the Registration Statement in the context of the Company's Initial Public Offering in accordance with the requirements stipulated in the Law No. 8 of 1995 concerning the Capital Market, which is contained in the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 64 of 1995, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 3608 and its implementing regulations ("UUPM") and their amendments include OJK Regulation No. 7/POJK.04/2017 concerning Registration Statement Documents for Public Offering of Equity Securities, Debt Securities, and/or Sukuk.

The Company officially conducted an Initial Public Offering (IPO) on the Indonesia Stock Exchange on September 8, 2020 and became the 42nd issuer in 2020 or the 705st of the total issuers. The Company has set an offering price of IDR1,820 per share and has gone through a public offering process on 2 - 3 September 2020. PT Indo Premier Sekuritas has been appointed as the Underwriter in the Company's Initial Public Offering. The number of shares offered to public at that time was 114,380,700 shares or 13.78% of the total issued and paid-up capital of the Company after the Company's Initial Public Offering.

**Year 2023**
Tahun 2023

The Company has carried out a corporate action, namely Stock Split in a ratio of 1:10, where the Stock Split process has followed the procedures and provisions of applicable regulations, with the following details:

(i) The Company has obtained a principle approval from the Indonesian Stock Exchange regarding the Company's Stock Split plan as stated in the Indonesian Stock Exchange Letter No. S-07353/BEI.PP2/08-2023 dated 31 August 2023;

(ii) The Company has made Information Disclosure to the public regarding the Company's Stock Split plans on September 12, 2023;

Perseroan telah menyampaikan Pernyataan Pendaftaran sehubungan dengan Penawaran Umum kepada Otoritas Jasa Keuangan dengan Nomor 396/SGH-OJK/VII/2020 tanggal 25 Juni 2020 perihal Surat Pengantar untuk Pernyataan Pendaftaran dalam rangka Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham Perseroan dan perubahan dan/atau tambahan informasi yang terakhir disampaikan melalui Surat Nomor 529/SGH-OJK/VIII/2020 tanggal 28 Agustus 2020 perihal Surat Pengantar untuk Perubahan dan/atau Tambahan Dokumen dan/atau Informasi atas Pernyataan Pendaftaran dalam rangka Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham Perseroan sesuai dengan persyaratan yang ditetapkan dalam Undang-Undang No. 8 Tahun 1995 tentang Pasar Modal, yang dimuat dalam Lembaran Negara Republik Indonesia No. 64 Tahun 1995, Tambahan Lembaran Negara Republik Indonesia No. 3608 dan peraturan pelaksanaannya ("UUPM") serta perubahan-perubahannya antara lain Peraturan OJK No. 7/POJK.04/2017 tentang Dokumen Pernyataan Pendaftaran Dalam Rangka Penawaran Umum Efek Bersifat Ekuitas, Efek Bersifat Utang, dan/atau Sukuk.

Perseroan melakukan Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham (IPO) secara resmi di Bursa Efek Indonesia pada tanggal 8 September 2020 dan menjadi emiten ke-42 di tahun 2020 atau ke-705 dari total emiten. Perseroan telah menetapkan harga penawaran Rp1.820 per saham dan telah melalui proses penawaran umum pada 2 - 3 September 2020. PT Indo Premier Sekuritas telah ditunjuk sebagai Penjamin Emisi Efek dalam Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham Perseroan. Jumlah saham yang ditawarkan kepada masyarakat pada saat itu adalah 114.380.700 lembar saham atau 13,78% dari total modal ditempatkan dan disetor Perseroan setelah pelaksanaan Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham Perseroan.

Perseroan telah melaksanakan aksi korporasi yaitu Pemecahan Nilai Nominal Saham ("Stock Split") dengan perbandingan 1:10, yang mana proses Stock Split ini telah mengikuti prosedur dan ketentuan peraturan yang berlaku, dengan rincian sebagai berikut:

(i) Perseroan telah memperoleh persetujuan prinsip dari Bursa Efek Indonesia perihal rencana Stock Split Perseroan sebagaimana dituangkan di dalam Surat Bursa Efek Indonesia No. S-07353/BEI.PP2/08-2023 tanggal 31 Agustus 2023;

(ii) Perseroan telah melakukan Keterbukaan Informasi kepada masyarakat atas rencana Stock Split Perseroan pada tanggal 12 September 2023;

# Seed to Patient

As natural products are at the core of our product offering, we follow a "seed to patient" approach with respect to curcuma, a key ingredient in our Curcuma Group products. Natural medicines can vary considerably depending on how they are produced. Seed to Patient is a method where all of the processes involved in growing and manufacturing natural medicine are tightly controlled to reduce variability. This model is a holistic approach to research focused on each stage of the entire end-to-end product cycle. The process starts with a scientific approach for selecting standardized seeds from superior varieties of curcuma, which helps ensure a controlled and consistent process and product. We then work to innovate at each stage of the natural pharmaceutical value chain.

As part of our innovation process in herbal research, we are working to expand this approach to other ingredients, such as Echinacea, the key ingredient in our best-selling product, Imboost.

Dikarenakan produk herbal merupakan inti dari produk-produk yang ditawarkan, Grup SGH menerapkan konsep “Seed to Patient” untuk temulawak, yang merupakan bahan inti dari produk Grup Curcuma. Kualitas obat-obatan herbal dapat bervariasi tergantung pada bagaimana cara memproduksi. Seed to Patient adalah metode di mana semua proses yang terlibat dalam pembudidayaan dan proses produksi obat herbal dikontrol ketat untuk mengurangi variabilitas ini. Konsep ini merupakan pendekatan holistik untuk penelitian yang berfokus pada setiap tahapan siklus produk dari hulu ke hilir. Proses “Seed to Patient” dimulai dengan pendekatan ilmiah dalam memilih benih standar dari varietas unggul temulawak, yang membantu untuk memastikan proses dan produk yang terkendali dan konsisten. Grup SGH selanjutnya berupaya untuk melakukan innovasi pada setiap tahapan rantai nilai alami.

Sebagai bukti keseriusan kami dalam menghadirkan innovasi produk berbahan herbal, Grup SGH saat ini sedang berusaha untuk menerapkan proses ini ke bahan-bahan dasar lainnya seperti Echinacea yang merupakan bahan dasar utama produk best-seller kami, Imboost.

## Ganesa Widya Jasa Utama Award from the Bandung Institute of Technology (ITB)

Penganugerahan Penghargaan Ganesa Widya Jasa Utama dari Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB)

![img-57.jpeg](img-57.jpeg)

On July 3, 2025, Soho Global Health Tbk was selected as one of the recipients of the Ganesa Widya Jasa Utama Award from the Bandung Institute of Technology (ITB). The Ganesa Widya Jasa Utama Award is presented to individuals or institutions/companies that have demonstrated outstanding service and achievements in the development of science and technology (IPTEKS) at the international, national, and/or ITB levels.

Based on a recommendation from the Dean of the School of Pharmacy and an assessment by the Selection Committee, Soho was recognized for its contributions to ITB and the advancement of science and technology, and was therefore granted the Ganesa Widya Jasa Utama Award. The award was presented directly by the Rector of ITB, Prof. Dr. Ir. Tatacipta Dirgantara, M.T., during the Open Session Commemorating 105 Years of Higher Technical Education in Indonesia, held at the West Hall of the ITB Campus in Bandung. Diani Savitri represented Soho in receiving the award.

In addition to the Ganesa Widya Jasa Utama Award, the Rector of ITB also presented the Ganesa Widya Jasa Adlutama, Ganesa Wirya Jasa Adlutama, Ganesa Wirya Jasa Utama, Ganesa Widya Jasa, and Ganesa Wira Adlutama awards to individuals, institutions, or companies that have demonstrated service and contributions to ITB and the development of science and technology (IPTEKS) across various fields of knowledge.

Pada tanggal 3 Juli 2025 yang lalu, Soho Global Health Tbk terpilih menjadi salah satu perusahaan yang menerima Penganugerahan Penghargaan Ganesa Widya Jasa Utama dari Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB). Penghargaan Ganesa Widya Jasa Utama dianugerahkan kepada individu atau institusi/perusahaan yang telah menunjukkan jasa dan prestasi dalam melaksanakan kegiatan pengembangan IPTEKS di tingkat international, nasional, dan atau ITB.

Berdasarkan masukan dari Dekan Sekolah Farmasi dan hasil penilaian dari Komisi Penyeleksi, Soho dinilai telah menunjukkan jasa dan kontribusi kepada ITB serta pengembangan IPTEKS, sehingga dianugerahkan Penghargaan Ganesa Widya Jasa Utama. Penghargaan tersebut diberikan langsung oleh Rektor ITB, Prof. Dr. Ir. Tatacipta Dirgantara, M.T., pada acara Sidang Terbuka Peringatan 105 Tahun Pendidikan Tinggi Teknik di Indonesia yang bertempat di Aula Barat Kampus ITB, Bandung. Dari Soho, penerima penghargaan diwakili oleh Diani Savitri.

Selain Penghargaan Ganesa Widya Jasa Utama, Rektor ITB juga memberikan Penghargaan Ganesa Widya Jasa Adlutama, Ganesa Wirya Jasa Adlutama, Ganesa Wirya Jasa Utama, Ganesa Widya Jasa, dan Ganesa Wira Adlutama kepada individu/institusi/perusahaan yang telah menunjukkan jasa dan kontribusi kepada ITB serta pengembangan IPTEKS di berbagai bidang keilmuan.

# Profile of Head of Internal Audit Unit

## Profil Kepala Unit Audit Internal

The Internal Audit Unit is led by a Head of the Internal Audit Unit who is appointed by the Board of Directors through a Decree of the Board of Directors. The Internal Audit Unit is responsible to the President Director and acts independently in carrying out its duties and responsibilities. In carrying out its responsibilities, the Internal Audit Unit also collaborates and coordinates with the Audit Committee.

The Internal Audit Unit was formed based on the Decree of the Company's Directors Number 05/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 concerning the Establishment of the Company's Internal Audit Unit dated 19 June 2020.

Mr. Devy Heriyanto was appointed as the Head of the Company's Internal Audit Unit as of February 21, 2025, replacing Mr. Patrick Lian Abuan Go, based on the Company's Board of Directors Decree Number 01/SK-DIR/SOHO/II/2025 concerning Dismissal and Appointment of the Head of Internal Audit Unit of PT Soho Global Health Tbk.

The Internal Audit Unit submits a report on the results of the audits it has carried out as well as objective suggestions and recommendations for improvement to the President Director and the Audit Committee.

Unit Audit Internal dipimpin oleh seorang Kepala Unit Audit Internal yang ditunjuk oleh Direksi melalui suatu Surat Keputusan Direksi. Unit Audit Internal bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden Direktur dan bertindak secara independen dalam melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya. Dalam melaksanakan tanggung jawabnya tersebut, Unit Audit Internal juga bekerjasama dan berkoordinasi dengan Komite Audit.

# Recruitment and Selection

## Rekrutmen dan Seleksi

As a company operating in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sector, SOHO Global Health Group consistently upholds the values of integrity, professionalism, and social responsibility in all aspects of its operations, including employee recruitment and selection process. In its efforts to build a healthy, inclusive, and competitive work environment, the Company is committed to conducting recruitment processes in a fair, transparent, and accountable manner, free from any form of discrimination.

The Company ensures that every individual is provided with equal opportunity to join the Company, regardless of gender, race, skin color, ethnicity, religion, disability status, or other social and cultural backgrounds. The selection process is based solely on the candidates' competencies, qualifications, and integrity, in order to support the Company's long-term success in delivering safe, effective, and reliable healthcare products and services.

As part of its commitment to ethical and responsible employment practices, SOHO Global Health Group implements a minimum age requirement for all applicants in accordance with applicable national laws and regulations as well as international labor standards, to prevent child labor practices and protect the rights of young workers.

To meet its human resources' need, the Company actively recruits both fresh graduates and experienced professionals with objectives aligned with the company's success. In addition, the Company selectively re-employs retirees as subject-matter experts in specific fields. This strategy also represents one of the measures adopted by the Company in implementing its principles of inclusion.

By applying these principles, the Company aims to create a work environment that reflects diversity, respects differences, and encourage fosters sustainable growth and innovation in support of its mission to improve the quality of life of society through excellent healthcare solutions.

# Employee Turnover

## Tingkat Pergantian Karyawan

Employee turnover is an important indicator in human capital management that reflects workforce movement within the organization. Changes in employee composition during the reporting period are part of organizational processes that include the completion of contract, career transitions, retirement, and other circumstances, all of which occur in accordance with Company policies and applicable regulations.

The objectives of this report include enabling the Company to evaluate its overall employee turnover rate, identify the main factors contributing to employee turnover, analyse the financial and non-financial impacts of turnover, and formulate strategic to improve employee retention in the future.

During 2025, the number of employees who ceased employment with the Company was recorded at 170 individuals. The reasons for the termination of employment included voluntary resignation, expiration of employment contracts, failure to pass the probationary period, retirement, death, as well as resignations resulting from termination of employment by the Company. This figure represents 7.1% (the total number of employees departures from 01 January to 31 December 2025 compared to the average number of employees during the same period).

Employee turnover has an impact on the Company not only from a non-financial perspective but also financially. These financial impacts include costs incurred in the recruitment and selection process, the implementation of onboarding and training programs, as well as other operational expenses.

Based on this analysis, the Company continues to strengthen employee development and training programs, review compensation and benefits policies to ensure competitiveness, enhance employee engagement through effective communication and sustainable leadership, and optimize the performance management system to create a work environment that supports sustainability and employee loyalty.

As part of its commitment to human capital sustainability, the Company consistently innovates and strives to create a conducive and productive work environment that is aligned with employees' expectations and needs.

Perputaran karyawan merupakan indikator penting dalam pengelolaan sumber daya manusia yang mencerminkan dinamika pergerakan tenaga kerja dalam organisasi. Perubahan komposisi karyawan selama periode pelaporan merupakan bagian dari proses organisasi yang mencakup penyelesaian masa kontrak, transisi karier, pensiun, serta kondisi lainnya yang berlangsung sesuai dengan ketentuan perusahaan dan peraturan yang berlaku.

Tujuan dari laporan ini antara lain digunakan Perusahaan untuk mengevaluasi tingkat perputaran karyawan secara keseluruhan, mengidentifikasi faktor-faktor penyebab utama dari perputaran karyawan, menganalisis dampak finansial dan non-finansial akibat turnover, serta merumuskan strategi untuk meningkatkan retensi karyawan di masa mendatang.

Selama tahun 2025, jumlah karyawan yang berhenti bekerja dari Perusahaan tercatat sebanyak 170 orang. Alasan berakhirnya hubungan kerja meliputi pengunduran diri secara sukarela, berakhirnya masa kontrak, tidak lulus masa percobaan, pensiun, meninggal dunia, serta pengunduran diri karena pengakhiran hubungan kerja oleh perusahaan. Jumlah tersebut setara dengan 7,1% (total karyawan yang berhenti dari 01 Januari sampai dengan 31 Desember 2025 dibandingkan dengan jumlah rata-rata karyawan pada periode yang sama).

Perputaran karyawan memberikan dampak tidak hanya dari sisi non-finansial, tetapi juga secara finansial terhadap perusahaan. Dampak finansial tersebut mencakup biaya yang timbul dalam proses rekrutmen dan seleksi, pelaksanaan program orientasi dan pelatihan, serta biaya operasional lainnya.

Berdasarkan analisis tersebut, Perusahaan berupaya untuk terus memperkuat program pengembangan dan pelatihan karyawan, evaluasi kebijakan kompensasi dan benefit agar tetap kompetitif, peningkatan keterlibatan karyawan melalui komunikasi yang efektif dan kepemimpinan yang berkelanjutan, serta optimalisasi sistem manajemen kinerja guna menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang mendukung keberlanjutan dan loyalitas karyawan.

Sebagai bentuk komitmen terhadap keberlanjutan sumber daya manusia, perusahaan senantiasa berinovasi dan terus berupaya menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang kondusif, produktif, serta selaras dengan harapan dan kebutuhan karyawan.

# Outsourced Employees

## Karyawan Alih Daya

In order to maintain operational efficiency while ensuring that the Company's remain focused on its core business activities, the Company implements an outsourcing scheme through partnerships with third-party service providers. This scheme is utilized to support non-core functions, such as security, cleaning services, administrative support, and other general operation activities.

By the end of 2025, the number of outsourced personnel supporting the Company's operations was recorded at 676 workers, spread across various business units and operational areas.

The Company ensures that its outsourcing service providers comply with applicable labor laws and regulations in Indonesia, including the fulfillment of workers' statutory rights, as well as adherence to quality standards, and Occupational Safety, and Health (OSH).

Through structured management of outsourced personnel, the Company was able to maintain service quality, enhance efficiency, and remain focused on the development of internal competencies in support of the achievement of its long-term strategic objectives.

Dalam rangka menjaga efisiensi operasional sekaligus memastikan fokus Perusahaan pada aktivitas bisnis intinya, Perusahaan menerapkan skema alih daya melalui kemitraan dengan perusahaan penyedia layanan pihak ketiga. Skema ini digunakan untuk mendukung fungsi-fungsi non-inti, seperti keamanan, layanan kebersihan, administrasi pendukung serta operasional umum lainnya.

## a. Minimum Wage
## Upah Minimum

SGH Group demonstrates a strong commitment to complying with the regulations of the Government of Indonesia, particularly those concerning the Provincial Minimum Wage (UMP) and the City/Regency Minimum Wage (UMK). The Company ensures that all employees receive remuneration that is not lower than the stipulated UMP/UMK and consistently adheres to annual increases in UMP/UMK in accordance with the respective Provincial Governor Regulations across Indonesia.

SGH Group also implements a Wage Structure and Scale in compliance with applicable laws and regulations. This remuneration structure is based on job level, competency, and individual performance. The Company consistently ensures internal equity and alignment.

The Company is actively committed to periodically reviewing overall wage compliance to ensure adherence to the provisions set by the Government of Indonesia and to maintain fair and competitive remuneration practices. In addition, SGH Group does not differentiate remuneration between male and female employees.

Due to the confidentiality of the remuneration structure, during this reporting period the Company does not disclose the ratio between the highest annual compensation received by an individual and the average total annual compensation of all employees.

SGH Group menunjukkan komitmen tinggi untuk mematuhi peraturan Pemerintah Indonesia, khususnya mengenai Upah Minimum Provinsi (UMP) dan Upah Minimum Kota (UMK). Perusahaan memastikan seluruh karyawan menerima imbal jasa tidak di bawah UMP/UMK yang telah ditetapkan, serta secara konsisten mengikuti kenaikan UMP/UMK dari tahun ke tahun sesuai dengan Peraturan Gubernur masing-masing Provinsi di Indonesia.

SGH Group juga menerapkan Struktur dan Skala Upah sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Struktur remunerasi ini didasarkan pada tingkat jabatan, kompetensi, dan kinerja masing-masing karyawan. Perusahaan selalu memastikan keadilan dan keselarasan internal.

Perusahaan berkomitmen secara aktif dan berkala meninjau kesesuaian upah secara keseluruhan agar memenuhi ketentuan yang ditetapkan oleh Pemerintah Indonesia dan menjaga praktik remunerasi yang adil dan kompetitif. Selain itu, SGH Group tidak membedakan remunerasi antara karyawan laki-laki dan perempuan.

Karena alasan kerahasiaan struktur remunerasi, pada periode ini Perusahaan tidak melaporkan rasio kompensasi tahunan tertinggi yang diterima individu dibandingkan dengan rata-rata total kompensasi tahunan seluruh karyawan.

# Periodic Medical Check-up for SGH Group Employees Year 2025

Pemeriksaan Kesehatan Berkala Karyawan SGH Group Tahun 2025

As part of the Company's commitment to supporting employee health and well-being, in 2025 the Company once again conducted Periodic Medical Check-up, which took place from 6 August to 13 September 2025. The program was attended by more than 2,200 employees from various units and work locations, reflecting a high level of participation and strong awareness of the importance of regular health monitoring.

The examinations were aimed at the early detection of potential health risks, while also ensuring that employees are in optimal physical condition to support productivity and operational performance. In addition, this initiative forms part of the Company's preventive efforts to anticipate the potential occurrence of occupational accidents and work-related illnesses.

To ensure the quality of results and the accuracy of health data, the Company collaborated with hospital service providers for the health examinations that had undergone a rigorous selection process, including administrative verification, assessment of technical capabilities, and on-site visits to the relevant healthcare facilities.

The results of these examinations serve as the basis for evaluating the Company's occupational health programs as well as for planning health initiatives for the 2025-2026 period, ensuring that the strategies implemented are aligned with employees' actual needs. Through this initiative, the Company reaffirms its commitment to creating a healthy, safe, and supportive work environment that promotes the holistic well-being of all employees.

Sebagai wujud komitmen Perusahaan dalam mendukung kesejahteraan dan kesehatan Karyawan, pada tahun 2025 Perusahaan kembali melaksanakan Pemeriksaan Kesehatan Berkala yang berlangsung pada tanggal 6 Agustus sampai dengan 13 September 2025. Kegiatan ini diikuti oleh lebih dari 2,200 karyawan dari berbagai unit dan lokasi kerja, mencerminkan partisipasi yang tinggi serta kepedulian terhadap pentingnya pemantauan kondisi kesehatan secara rutin.

Pemeriksaan ini bertujuan untuk melakukan deteksi dini terhadap potensi risiko kesehatan, sekaligus memastikan bahwa karyawan berada dalam kondisi fisik yang prima untuk menunjang produktivitas dan kinerja operasional. Selain itu, kegiatan ini juga menjadi bagian dari upaya preventif Perusahaan dalam mengantisipasi kemungkinan terjadinya kecelakaan kerja maupun Penyakit Akibat Kerja (PAK).

Untuk menjamin kualitas hasil dan akurasi data kesehatan, Perusahaan bekerja sama dengan rumah sakit penyedia layanan pemeriksaan Kesehatan, yang telah melalui proses seleksi ketat, termasuk verifikasi administratif, penilaian kapabilitas teknis, serta kunjungan langsung ke fasilitas penyedia layanan pemeriksaan Kesehatan yang dimaksud.

Hasil dari pemeriksaan ini digunakan sebagai dasar evaluasi program kesehatan kerja sekaligus perencanaan inisiatif kesehatan untuk periode 2025-2026, agar strategi yang diimplementasikan selaras dengan kebutuhan nyata karyawan. Melalui kegiatan ini, Perusahaan menegaskan komitmennya dalam menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang sehat, aman, dan mendukung kesejahteraan holistik seluruh karyawan.

# Employee Training and Development

## Pelatihan & Pengembangan Karyawan

Training and development represent a long-term investment that plays a vital role in strengthening individual capabilities as well as the organization's overall competitiveness. By continuously updated skills, employees are able to work more effectively, adapt to organizational changes, respond swiftly to increasingly competitive market dynamics, and contribute to the Company's long-term sustainability.

At SGH Group, training and development initiatives are not limited to the employees itself, but also extend to freelancers, interns, fieldwork and on-the-job training participants, as well as outsourced personnel.

Throughout 2025, the Company conducted training and development programs for its workforce with a total duration of 16,834 hours. Based on these total training hours, by the end of 2025 each individual received on average, training and development opportunities amounting to 5.5 hours per individual per year.

Pelatihan dan pengembangan merupakan investasi jangka panjang yang berperan penting dalam meningkatkan kemampuan individu maupun daya saing organisasi. Dengan keterampilan yang diperbarui secara konsisten, karyawan akan mampu bekerja lebih efektif, adaptif terhadap perubahan organisasi, sigap menghadapi dinamika pasar yang semakin kompetitif, serta menjaga keberlanjutan Perusahaan.

Pelatihan dan pengembangan di SGH Group tidak hanya ditujukan bagi karyawan, namun juga bagi pekerja lepas, peserta magang dan peserta praktik kerja lapangan, hingga tenaga alih daya.

Selama tahun 2025, Perusahaan telah menyelenggarakan pelatihan dan pengembangan bagi tenaga kerja dengan total durasi mencapai 16.834 jam. Pelatihan internal pada umumnya dilakukan sebagai bagian dari proses mentransfer pengetahuan dan pengalaman kerja dari pimpinan atau karyawan yang lebih ahli kepada yang masih membutuhkan pelatihan. Pelatihan eksternal ditujukan bagi karyawan yang membutuhkan kompetensi khusus ataupun pengetahuan dan keahlian profesional yang belum dapat difasilitasi secara internal. Jenis pelatihan dan pengembangan yang diselenggarakan juga beragam, mulai dari penguatan keterampilan teknis seperti presentasi; penanganan keluhan; pemanfaatan teknologi; hingga pelatihan khusus yang mendukung kepemimpinan. Selain itu, Perusahaan juga mendorong budaya belajar mandiri melalui akses ke kanal pembelajaran digital, webinar, dan sesi berbagi pengetahuan antar karyawan, sehingga pembelajaran tidak hanya berlangsung di ruangan tetapi juga dalam keseharian pekerjaan.

# b. SGH Webinar Series

As a company committed to sustainable growth, SGH Group believes that human resources development is a critical investment for the growth and long-term sustainability of the Company. Continuous development fosters innovation, enhances competitiveness, and cultivates a positive workplace culture.

In line with this commitment, the Company has introduced the SGH Webinar Series since 2020 a dedicated platform designed to enrich employees' knowledge and insights. The program is accessible to employees located at both the Head Office and Branch Offices across Indonesia.

This program is not merely an information-sharing forum, but an interactive platform that enables employees to learn directly from subject matter experts. Each session is designed to provide in-depth understanding of various contemporary topics, ranging from health talks to promote well-being, financial talks to strengthen personal financial literacy, leadership sharing sessions, as well as other relevant and current topics.

Sebagai Perusahaan yang berkomitmen pada pertumbuhan berkelanjutan, SGH Group meyakini bahwa pengembangan sumber daya manusia merupakan investasi penting bagi pertumbuhan dan keberlanjutan sebuah perusahaan. Pengembangan yang berkelanjutan akan mendorong inovasi, meningkatkan daya saing, dan menciptakan budaya kerja yang positif.

Setiap sesi dirancang untuk memberikan pemahaman mendalam tentang berbagi topik terkini, mulai dari bincang sehat untuk meningkatkan kesadaran akan kesehatan, diskusi finansial untuk memperkuat literasi keuangan pribadi, hingga sesi sharing dari para pimpinan, dan topik terkini lainnya.

# f. On-the-Job Training
## On-the-Job Training

The Company conducts on-the-job training as part of its strategy to develop employees' competencies in a practical and application-oriented manner. On-the-job training provides employees with the opportunity to learn their duties and responsibilities directly within the workplace, under the guidance of supervisors, mentors, or more experienced colleagues.

The on-the-job training program enables employees to gain a thorough understanding of work processes, apply knowledge acquired through formal training, and tangibly enhance their technical and operational skills.

# Employee Annual Performance Review

## Evaluasi Kinerja Tahunan Karyawan

To ensure the achievement of the Company's strategies and objectives and their alignment with individual performance targets, the Company conducts periodic performance review covering all employees (100%) at least once annually. As of 2025, SGH Group continues to implement the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) methodology, which is cascaded to the individual level and referred to as the Personal Scorecard (PSC). The PSC functions as a performance measurement instrument encompassing the four perspectives of the BSC, supported by clearly defined, relevant, and measurable key performance indicators. Through this approach, individual contributions are assessed in a measurable and quantitative manner.

The Company has established a structured and systematic performance management framework. The cascading process of the scorecard to the individual level is initiated through the translation of the Company's strategic objectives at the Top Management level, subsequently extended to the Business Unit Leadership level, and further cascaded to individual employees for a defined performance period. To ensure that the performance review process is conducted in a fair, objective, and accountable manner, evaluations are performed by both direct and indirect supervisors in accordance with the performance measurement policies and procedures stipulated by the Company.

The results of the performance reviews serve several essential functions, including the determination of individual performance levels, the identification of competency and development needs, and the provision of a basis for the formulation of appropriate development programs, coaching, and guidance in accordance with each employee's respective roles and responsibilities.

The performance appraisal system implemented by SGH Group is carried out in accordance with the following provisions:

Untuk memastikan bahwa strategi dan tujuan Perusahaan dapat dicapai dan selaras dengan sasaran kinerja setiap individu, Perusahaan secara berkala melakukan penilaian kinerja terhadap seluruh karyawan (100%) setidaknya satu kali dalam satu tahun. Sampai dengan tahun 2025, SGH Group masih menggunakan metode Balanced Scorecard (BSC) yang diturunkan sampai ke level individu dan dikenal dengan Personal Scorecard (PSC). PSC ini merupakan alat ukur kinerja yang mencakup empat perspektif BSC yang disertai indikator-indikator kinerja yang jelas, relevan, dan terukur. Dengan demikian, kontribusi setiap individu dapat diukur secara kuantitatif.

Perusahaan juga mengatur pelaksanaan manajemen kinerja yang terarah dan sistematis. Proses penurunan scorecard sampai ke level individu ini dimulai dengan penurunan strategi Perusahaan ke Manajemen Tertinggi, kemudian ke level Pimpinan Unit Bisnis, kemudian dilanjutkan sampai ke tingkat individu pada periode tahun tertentu. Untuk memastikan proses penilaian kinerja bersifat adil dan objektif, evaluasi dilakukan oleh atasan langsung dan atasan tidak langsung mengikuti ketentuan pengukuran yang telah ditetapkan Perusahaan.

Hasil dari penilaian kinerja ini memiliki beberapa fungsi krusial, antara lain menentukan tingkat kinerja individu, mengidentifikasi area pengembangan yang diperlukan, serta menjadi dasar untuk mendesain program dan bimbingan yang tepat bagi tiap individu pada lingkup pekerjaan masing-masing.

# 360-Degree Feedback

## Umpan Balik 360 Derajat

Another assessment tool used by the Company, particularly to evaluate employee behavioral aspects in the workplace, is the 360-Degree Feedback. This method is designed to collect anonymous feedback from various parties who interact directly with the employee being assessed, including supervisors, subordinates (both direct and indirect), peers, and other colleagues with whom the employee has direct interactions. Through this multi-perspective approach, management was able to obtain a comprehensive view of individual work behaviors, which serves as a foundation for more targeted and sustainable competency development.

The implementation of 360-Degree Feedback within SGH Group assesses, among other things, leadership capabilities, communication skills, and the alignment of employee behavior with the Company's Purpose, Vision, and Core Values (PVCV). This approach enables the Company to identify individual strengths as well as areas that require further attention and improvement.

The results of the 360-Degree Feedback are subsequently integrated into individual development plans, coaching, mentoring, training programs, and other strategic assignments. This integration ensures that the development process is continuous, aligned with organizational needs, and expected to have a positive impact on enhancing individual performance.

In 2025, the 360-Degree Feedback process was conducted, among others, for Managers in the Accounting and Finance, Tax, Business Development, Business Technology, and Procurement divisions. The year 2025 marked the second year of implementation of the 360-Degree Feedback for this group, as part of the Company's ongoing efforts to expand the application of comprehensive evaluation practices and to promote holistic and sustainable talent development.

Alat ukur lainnya yang digunakan Perusaahan terutama dalam menilai aspek perilaku karyawan di lingkungan kerja adalah dengan Umpan Balik 360 Derajat. Metode ini dirancang untuk mengumpulkan umpan balik anonim dari berbagai pihak yang berinteraksi langsung dengan karyawan yang sedang dinilai, mulai dari atasan, bawahan (langsung maupun tidak langsung), rekan kerja dengan jabatan yang sejajar, dan rekan kerja lainnya yang melakukan interaksi secara langsung. Melalui pendekatan multi-perspektif ini, Pimpinan mampu melihat gambaran menyeluruh mengenai perilaku kerja individu sebagai dasar pengembangan kompetensi yang lebih terarah dan berkesinambungan.

Pelaksanaan Umpan Balik 360 Derajat di SGH Group antara lain menilai aspek kepemimpinan, aspek komunikasi, serta kesesuaian perilaku karyawan dengan Tujuan, Visi, dan Nilai-nilai Utama Perusahaan. Pendekatan ini memungkinkan Perusahaan mengidentifikasi kekuatan setiap individu serta area yang memerlukan perhatian lebih.

Hasil dari Umpan Balik 360 Derajat selanjutnya diintegrasikan ke dalam rencana pengembangan individu, baik melalui coaching, mentoring, pelatihan, maupun penugasan strategis lainnya. Integrasi ini memastikan bahwa proses pengembangan yang dijalankan bersifat berkelanjutan, selaras dengan kebutuhan organisasi, dan diharapkan dapat memberikan dampak positif terhadap peningkatan kinerja individu.

# Business Review

Tinjauan Usaha [POJK B.1]

## Consumer Health Segment

Divisi Produk Kesehatan Konsumen

## Overview

The Consumer Health segment comprises a broad portfolio of products that do not require a doctor's prescription and are marketed directly to consumers through multiple channels, including retail stores, pharmacies, and e-commerce platforms. In addition, these products are also promoted through healthcare professionals and healthcare facilities such as hospitals and clinics. Key brands in this segment include Imboost Force and Imboost Regular, Curcuma Force, Noroid, Asthin, Curcuma Plus Vitamin, Fitkom, Diapet, and Laxing.

## 2025 Achievements

In 2025, the Consumer Health segment delivered strong growth, with net sales reaching Rp1.15 trillion, representing a 24.6% increase compared to 2024 and contributing 10.7% to SGH's total net sales. Gross profit margin improved to 75.5% from 73.8% in the previous year, reflecting a stronger mix of higher-value products and continued optimization of distribution channels.

Throughout the year, Imboost remained the primary contributor to the segment's performance and maintained its position as one of the leading brands in the immune supplement category. Growth was further supported by strong performance in the e-commerce channel, particularly from Asthin, Noroid, and Curcuma Plus Vitamin, which continue to strengthen their presence across digital platforms. Meanwhile, hospital, clinic, and retail channels continued to provide stable sales contributions, supported by products such as Curcuma Force, Boost D, Fitkom, and Diapet.

Based on IQVIA Indonesia Total Market data for Q4-2025, Imboost ranked 5th among the top 10 best-selling pharmaceutical products in Indonesia across both prescription and OTC categories, and ranked 1st in the vitamin category (excluding ready-to-drink products). This achievement further reinforces the Company's strong position in Indonesia's consumer healthcare market.

## Gambaran Umum

Segmen Kesehatan Konsumen mencakup portofolio produk yang luas yang tidak memerlukan resep dokter dan dipasarkan secara langsung kepada konsumen melalui berbagai saluran, termasuk toko ritel, apotek, dan platform e-commerce. Selain itu, produk-produk dalam segmen ini juga dipromosikan melalui tenaga kesehatan serta fasilitas layanan kesehatan seperti rumah sakit dan klinik. Merek-merek utama dalam segmen ini meliputi Imboost Force dan Imboost Regular, Curcuma Force, Noroid, Asthin, Curcuma Plus Vitamin, Fitkom, Diapet, dan Laxing.

## Pencapaian 2025

Pada tahun 2025, Segmen Kesehatan Konsumen mencatatkan pertumbuhan yang kuat dengan penjualan bersih mencapai Rp1,15 trillion, meningkat 24,6% dibandingkan tahun 2024, serta memberikan kontribusi sebesar 10,7% terhadap total penjualan bersih SGH. Margin laba kotor meningkat menjadi 75,5% dari 73,8% pada tahun sebelumnya, mencerminkan komposisi portofolio produk bernilai tambah tinggi serta optimalisasi pengelolaan kanal distribusi.

Sepanjang tahun, Imboost tetap menjadi kontributor utama bagi kinerja segmen dan mempertahankan posisinya sebagai salah satu merek terkemuka di kategori suplemen daya tahan tubuh. Pertumbuhan juga didorong oleh kinerja yang kuat di kanal e-commerce, terutama dari merek Asthin, Noroid, dan Curcuma Plus Vitamin yang semakin memperkuat kehadirannya di platform digital. Di sisi lain, kanal rumah sakit, klinik, dan ritel tetap memberikan kontribusi penjualan yang stabil, didukung oleh produk-produk seperti Curcuma Force, Boost D, Fitkom, dan Diapet.

Berdasarkan data IQVIA Indonesia Total Market Q4-2025, Imboost menempati peringkat ke-5 di antara 10 produk farmasi terlaris di Indonesia baik dalam kategori resep maupun OTC, serta peringkat pertama dalam kategori vitamin (di luar ready-to-drink). Pencapaian ini semakin memperkuat posisi Perseroan sebagai salah satu pemain utama di pasar consumer healthcare di Indonesia.

# Distribution and Logistic

## Divisi Distribusi dan Logistik

### Overview

We established our distribution business in 1956, giving us a long track record as a successful pharmaceutical and consumer goods distribution partner. As the distribution arm of SOHO Global Health (the "Group"), Parit Padang Global (PPG) distributes both our own products and products for over 50 third-party partners ("PPG Principals"). We are distributors for Indonesian Pharmaceutical & MedTech companies, such as Yarindo, Fahrenheit, Dipa Pharmalab, Global Dispomedika (GDM), Berno, Pharos Indonesia, Mahakam Beta Farma, Kalbe Farma, Hexpharm Jaya, Sari Enesis and multinational companies, such as Johnson & Johnson, iNova, BBraun, Kenvue, Eisai, IDS Med, Hetero (Amarox), Fresenius Medical Care, L'Oreal, 3M and Parvus. We represent more than two-thirds of our PPG portfolio of products on an exclusive basis, which can vary in scope and range from nationwide exclusivity to market channel or product exclusivity.

Distribution through PPG is a key enabler for our Professional Products Consumer Health and Alliance businesses. Our extensive distribution network ensures that any new products we launch are available across Indonesia through all of our distribution channels, from hospitals to minimarkets.

Our logistic network provides extensive coverage across the entire Indonesian archipelago, with a reach of approximately 95% of hospitals and pharmacies in Indonesia, as well as many modern and traditional outlets. This is made possible through our 25 branches and three sales offices, as well as over 30 third-party sub-distributors.

Our platform is supported by over 500 outsourced intermediate and last-mile delivery vehicles, as well as a cold storage logistics chain for products that require 2-8 degree Celsius warehousing. Our distribution network has the capacity to handle over 27,900 pallets across all branches, including our central warehouse. We are proud to be one of the few distributors in Indonesia awarded the International Good Storage and Distribution Practice Certificate from the Societe Generale de Surveillance, as well as the ISO 9001:2015 certificate for quality management systems, the Certificate of Method of Good Distribution of Medicines (CDOB) from BPOM RI, and the Certificate of Method of Good Distribution of Healthcare Devices (CDAKB).

### 2025 Highlights

The Distribution and Logistics Division registered single-digit net sales growth in 2025, rising from IDR 8,871 billion to IDR 9,333 billion, which represents a 5.2% increase. This performance was mainly due to the success of existing principals as well as new principal additions. However, the gross profit margin remained strong at 8.4% due to well managed product portfolio mix.

Our strong sales growth, reflects our deliberate strategy to build sustainable competitive advantage through digitalization and automation. One of the key pillars of this transformation is PPGOS (PPG Online System) — our proprietary B2B digital platform designed to strengthen customer engagement and operational efficiency.

### Gambaran Umum

Kami telah mendirikan bisnis distribusi sejak tahun 1956, dan hingga kini telah menunjukkan rekam jejak yang panjang sebagai mitra distribusi yang sukses untuk produk farmasi dan produk konsumen. Sebagai kepanjangan tangan distribusi dari SOHO Global Health ("Grup"), Parit Padang Global (PPG) mendistribusikan produk-produk milik Grup SGH dan produk untuk lebih dari 50 mitra pihak ketiga ("Prinsipal PPG"). Kami adalah distributor untuk perusahaan farmasi & alat kesehatan lokal, seperti Yarindo, Fahrenheit, Dipa Pharmalab, Global Dispomedika (GDM), Berno, Pharos Indonesia, Mahakam Beta Farma, Kalbe Farma, Hexpharm Jaya, Sari Enesis dan perusahaan multinasional, seperti Johnson & Johnson, iNova, BBraun, Kenvue, Eisai, IDS Med, Hetero (Amarox), Fresenius Medical Care, L'Oreal, 3M and Parvus. Sebanyak dua per tiga dari produk dalam portofolio produk PPG kami distribusikan secara eksklusif, yang memiliki ruang lingkup berbeda-beda dari eksklusivitas secara nasional hingga eksklusivitas saluran pasar atau eksklusivitas produk.

Distribusi melalui PPG merupakan pendorong Utama pertumbuhan bisnis Produk Profesional, dan Kesehatan Konsumen dan bisnis Alliance kami. Jaringan distribusi kami yang luas memastikan bahwa semua produk baru yang kami luncurkan tersedia di seluruh Indonesia melalui semua saluran distribusi PPG, dari rumah sakit hingga minimarket.

Jaringan logistik kami menyediakan cakupan yang luas di seluruh kepulauan Indonesia, dengan jangkauan sekitar 95% rumah sakit dan apotek di Indonesia, serta gerai-gerai modern dan tradisional. Hal ini dimungkinkan melalui cakupan 25 cabang dan tiga (3) kantor penjualan kami, serta lebih dari 30 subdistributor pihak ketiga.

Platform kami didukung oleh lebih dari 500 armada pengiriman, serta ruang penyimapanan pendingin (cold storage) untuk produk yang memerlukan penyimpanan suhu 2-8 derajat Celsius. Jaringan distribusi kami memiliki kapasitas untuk menangani lebih dari 27.900 palet di seluruh cabang, termasuk gudang pusat kami. Kami bangga menjadi salah satu distributor di Indonesia yang mendapatkan Sertifikat International Good Storage and Distribution Practice dari Societe Generale de Surveillance, serta sertifikasi ISO 9001:2015 untuk sistem manajemen mutu, Sertifikat Cara Distribusi Obat yang Baik (CDOB) dari BPOM RI, dan Sertifikat Cara Distribusi Alat Kesehatan yang Baik (CDAKB).

### Pencapaian 2025

Divisi Distribusi dan Logistik mencatat pertumbuhan penjualan bersih mencapai satu digit pada tahun 2025, naik dari IDR 8.871 menjadi IDR 9.333 miliar, atau mengalami peningkatan sebesar 5,2%. Kinerja ini terutama disebabkan oleh keberhasilan dari prinsipal-prinsipal lama dan prinsipal baru. Selain itu, margin laba kotor stabil di 8,4% karena adanya perubahan dalam bauran portofolio produk.

Pertumbuhan penjualan yang luar biasa ini, mencerminkan strategi yang telah dirancang untuk membangun keunggulan kompetitif yang berkelanjutan melalui digitalisasi dan otomatisasi. Salah satu pilar utama transformasi ini adalah PPGOS (PPG Online System) — platform digital B2B yang dirancang untuk memperkuat keterlibatan pelanggan dan efisiensi operasional.

Through PPGOS, we provide pharmacies, private hospitals, and clinics with seamless ordering capabilities, enhanced transparency, and improved service responsiveness. Since its nationwide launch in November 2019, the platform has demonstrated consistent and measurable progress. As of December 2025, PPGOS has registered over 28,500 active customers and contributes approximately 45% of total sales for channels served by digital ordering, reinforcing its strategic importance to the business.

Building on this solid foundation, PPGOS 2.0 has now evolved into PPGOS 3.0, marking the next phase of our digital transformation journey. While PPGOS 2.0 focused primarily on strengthening transactional efficiency through a scalable B2B e-commerce infrastructure, its rapid adoption and growing sales contribution confirmed its role as a core growth engine.

PPGOS 3.0 expands beyond transactional commerce into a comprehensive engagement ecosystem. It integrates professional education, gamification, community engagement, and in-store activation programs — enabling deeper collaboration with pharmacists, frontline staff, and purchasing decision-makers. At the same time, it empowers our principals with scalable digital tools to drive brand engagement, loyalty, productivity, and sustainable long-term growth.

Through this evolution, PPGOS is no longer merely a transaction platform, but a strategic digital asset that supports ecosystem-wide value creation.

Melalui PPGOS, kami menawarkan kemampuan pemesanan yang lancar, transparansi yang lebih baik, dan respons layanan yang lebih baik bagi apotek, rumah sakit swasta, dan klinik. Sejak peluncurannya secara nasional pada November 2019, platform ini telah menunjukkan kemajuan yang konsisten dan terukur. Hingga Desember 2025, PPGOS telah mencatat lebih dari 28.500 pelanggan aktif dan berkontribusi sekitar 45% dari total penjualan melalui saluran digital, memperkuat kepentingan strategisnya bagi bisnis.

Dengan fondasi yang kokoh ini, PPGOS 2.0 kini telah berevolusi menjadi PPGOS 3.0, menandai fase selanjutnya dari perjalanan proses transformasi digital. Meskipun PPGOS 2.0 memiliki fokus utama pada penguatan efisiensi transaksi melalui infrastruktur e-commerce B2B yang terukur, adopsinya yang cepat dan kontribusi penjualan yang terus meningkat menegaskan perannya sebagai mesin pertumbuhan inti.

PPGOS 3.0 berekspansi melampaui hubungan transaksional menjadi suatu ekosistem keterlibatan yang komprehensif. Ini mengintegrasikan pendidikan profesional, gamifikasi, keterlibatan komunitas, dan program aktivasi di outlet — memungkinkan kolaborasi yang lebih dalam dengan apoteker, staf garis depan, dan pengambil keputusan pembelian. Pada saat yang sama, hal ini juga memberdayakan prinsipal kami dengan alat digital yang terukur untuk mendorong keterlibatan merek, loyalitas, produktivitas, dan pertumbuhan jangka panjang yang berkelanjutan.

Dengan kata lain, PPGOS bukan lagi sekadar platform transaksi, tetapi berevolusi menjadi aset digital strategis yang mendukung penciptaan nilai di seluruh ekosistem.

## 2026 Strategies

The year 2026 will continue to see the ongoing expansion of both PPG's direct and indirect coverage (i.e., through the sub-distributor network). Process digitalization will remain a high priority, not just to deliver even more efficient supply chain performance but also to offer superior service and convenience to our customers.

In brief, PPG's future strategies will remain focused on the following:

- Growing sales, leveraging fixed costs, and expanding margins
- Relentlessly managing collection, working capital, and delivery costs
- Selectively pursuing the addition of new principals to succeed in 2026 and over the next 3 to 5 years, regardless of the demand environment
- Enhancing and growing the PPGOS platform and leverage technology to improve operational process and productivity

Bisnis distribusi kesehatan dan alat kesehatan terus mengalami manfaat dari meningkatnya permintaan setelah diluncurkannya JKN di Indonesia pada tahun 2014. Untuk lebih mendukung pasar yang semakin berkembang ini, PPG semakin memperkuat infrastruktur distribusi dan logistiknya, serta berencana untuk meningkatkan kapasitas gudang dan melakukan ekspansi geografis dan cakupan saluran distribusi dengan memanfaatkan jaringan sub-distributor kami.

## Strategi 2026

Fokus PPG di tahun 2026 akan terus mengembangkan ekspansi dari cakupan langsung dan tidak langsung PPG (yaitu melalui jaringan sub-distributor). Proses digitalisasi akan tetap menjadi prioritas utama, tidak hanya untuk memberikan kinerja rantai pasok yang lebih efisien, tetapi juga untuk menawarkan layanan dan kenyamanan yang superior kepada pelanggan kami.

Secara singkat, strategi masa depan PPG akan tetap difokuskan pada hal-hal berikut:

- Meningkatkan penjualan, memanfaatkan biaya tetap, dan memperluas margin
- Terus mengelola penagihan piutang, modal kerja, dan biaya pengiriman dengan tekun
- Secara selektif mengejar penambahan prinsipal baru pada tahun 2026 dan selama 3 hingga 5 tahun mendatang, terlepas dari kondisi ekonomi dan permintaan pasar
- Meningkatkan dan memperluas platform PPGOS dan menggunakan teknologi untuk meningkatkan proses dan produktifitas operasional.

Through strengthened brand presence on digital platforms as well as optimized management of official stores and digital marketing campaigns, brands such as Asthin, Noroid, and Curcuma Plus Vitamin recorded significant growth and successfully expanded their penetration to a broader consumer base.

On the other hand, Imboost remained the primary contributor and maintained its position as one of the leading brands in the immune supplement category in Indonesia. Meanwhile, conventional distribution channels such as hospitals, clinics, and modern retail continued to deliver stable sales contributions, supported by products such as Curcuma Force, Boost D, Fitkom, and Diapet. The combination of brand strengthening, digital channel expansion, and increasingly integrated omnichannel distribution management forms an important foundation for the sustained growth of the Consumer Health Segment.

## Receivables collectibility

At the end of 2025, the Company's accounts receivable collection period was 65 days, longer than the 60 days in the prior year. This was primarily attributable to slower payments from government hospitals in 2025 compared to 2024 and 2023, as a result of budget tightening and lower government funding allocated to the sector. Nevertheless, this remains within the normal range, and the Company continues to maintain operational discipline. All outstanding receivables are short-term in nature.

The collectibility of receivables is reviewed periodically. Management has also conducted a review based on the status of each business receivable on each reporting date and is confident that the provision for impairment losses as described in Note 5 of the Financial Statements is adequate to cover any losses that may arise from uncollectible receivables.

## Liquidity

To ensure availability of sufficient cash, the Treasury Department prepares cash flow forecasts and maintains funding flexibility through adequate credit facility management.

The Company has a reasonably strong liquidity position, with cash and cash equivalent of Rp1.1 trillion. At the end of 2025, the company's current ratio was 1.63.

## Capital structure

The Company's capital structure policy is aligned with and comply to the prevailing tax regulations, whereas the maximum allowable DER for tax purposes is 4:1. At year end 2025, the Company did not have any bank loan or other interest-bearing debt instruments.

## Tingkat kolektibilitas piutang

Pada akhir tahun 2025, periode penagihan piutang Perseroan (collection period) adalah 65 hari, lebih lama dibandingkan dengan 60 hari pada tahun sebelumnya. Hal ini terutama disebabkan oleh pembayaran dari rumah sakit pemerintah yang lebih lambat pada tahun 2025 dibandingkan dengan tahun 2024 dan 2023 sebagai akibat dari pengetatan anggaran dan besaran dana pemerintah yang lebih rendah yang dialokasikan ke sektor ini. Meskipun demikian, hal tersebut tetap berada dalam kisaran normal, dan Perusahaan terus menjaga disiplin operasional. Semua piutang yang masih belum lunas adalah piutang jangka pendek.

Kolektibilitas piutang ditinjau secara berkala. Manajemen juga telah melakukan penelaahan berdasarkan status masing-masing piutang usaha pada setiap tanggal pelaporan, dan berkeyakinan bahwa provisi atas kerugian penurunan nilai yang dijelaskan pada Catatan 5 Laporan Keuangan telah memadai untuk menutupi kerugian yang mungkin timbul dari piutang yang tidak tertagih.

## Likuiditas

Untuk memastikan ketersediaan kas, Departemen Treasury menyiapkan perkiraan kebutuhan arus kas dan memelihara fleksibilitas pendanaan dengan pengelolaan fasilitas kredit yang memadai.

Perseroan memiliki likuiditas yang cukup kuat dengan nilai kas dan setara kas sebesar Rp1,1 trillion. Rasio lancar Perseroan pada akhir tahun 2025 tercatat sebesar 1,63.

## Struktur modal

Kebijakan struktur modal Perseroan sejalan dan mematuhi peraturan pajak yang berlaku, dimana rasio maksimum DER yang diperbolehkan untuk tujuan perpajakan adalah 4:1. Pada akhir tahun 2025, Perseroan tidak memiliki utang bank atau instrumen utang berbunga lainnya.

# Implementation of new accounting standards

## Amendment of PSAK 221: Lack of Exchangeability

The amendment specifies how an entity should assess whether a currency is exchangeable and how it should determine a spot exchange rate when exchangeability is lacking. The amendment also require disclosure of information that enables users of its financial statements to understand how the currency not being exchangeable into the other currency affects, or is expected to affect, the entity's financial performance, financial position and cash flows.

## Amendment of PSAK 117: Insurance Contracts

PSAK 117 is a comprehensive new accounting standard for insurance contracts covering recognition and measurement, presentation and disclosure. PSAK 117 replaces PSAK 104: Insurance Contracts. PSAK 117 applies to all types of insurance contracts (i.e., life, non-life, direct insurance and re-insurance), regardless of the type of entities that issue them as well as to certain guarantees and financial instruments with discretionary participation features.

The overall objective of PSAK 117 is to provide a comprehensive accounting model for insurance contracts that is more useful and consistent for insurers, covering all relevant accounting aspects. PSAK 117 is based on a general model, supplemented by:

- A specific adaptation for contracts with direct participation features (the variable fee approach)
- A simplified approach (the premium allocation approach) mainly for short-duration contracts

The implementation of standards above had no material impact to the financial reporting and disclosure in the Group's consolidated financial statements.

# Penerapan pernyataan standar akuntansi baru

## Amendemen PSAK 221: Kekurangan Ketertukaran

Amandemen tersebut menetapkan bagaimana entitas harus menilai apakah suatu mata uang dapat dipertukarkan serta bagaimana entitas harus menentukan kurs spot ketika ketertukaran (exchangeability) tidak tersedia. Amandemen tersebut juga mensyaratkan pengungkapan informasi yang memungkinkan pengguna laporan keuangan untuk memahami bagaimana ketidakmampuan mata uang tersebut untuk dipertukarkan dengan mata uang lainnya memengaruhi, atau diharapkan akan memengaruhi, kinerja keuangan, posisi keuangan, dan arus kas entitas

## Amendemen PSAK 117: Kontrak Asuransi

PSAK 117 merupakan standar akuntansi baru yang komprehensif mencakup pengakuan dan pengukuran, penyajian, serta pengungkapan untuk kontrak asuransi. PSAK 117 menggantikan PSAK 104: Kontrak Asuransi. PSAK 117 berlaku untuk seluruh jenis kontrak asuransi (yaitu, jiwa, non-jiwa, asuransi langsung, dan reasuransi), tanpa memandang jenis entitas yang menerbitkannya, serta berlaku pula untuk jenis garansi tertentu dan instrumen keuangan dengan fitur partisipasi diskresioner.

Tujuan utama PSAK 117 adalah menyediakan model akuntansi yang komprehensif untuk kontrak asuransi yang lebih berguna dan konsisten bagi entitas asuransi, mencakup seluruh aspek akuntansi yang relevan. PSAK 117 didasarkan pada model umum yang dilengkapi dengan:

- Penyesuaian khusus untuk kontrak dengan fitur partisipasi langsung (variable fee approach)
- Pendekatan yang disederhanakan (premium allocation approach) yang terutama berlaku untuk kontrak berdurasi pendek

The Company is committed to operating at the highest standard of Good Corporate Governance. # Good Corporate Governance

## Tata Kelola Perusahaan Yang Baik

The Company realizes that the implementation of good corporate governance plays an important role in supporting accountability and increasing the success of the Company's business. The implementation of good corporate governance is also expected to increase the value of the Company as well as create a good and superior image for the Company in the future. Therefore, the Company is committed to implementing good corporate governance thoroughly in every aspect of the Company's functions with reference to all relevant regulations.

Based on Law No. 40 of 2007 on Limited Liability Companies as amended by Law No. 6 of 2023 on Job Creation, the corporate governance mechanism regulates the pattern of relationships and structures between the Company's main organs consisting of the GMS, the Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, as well as other supporting organs, namely the Audit Committee, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Internal Audit Unit, and the Corporate Secretary.

This structure is established to ensure the implementation of corporate governance principles in a systematic manner by clearly defining the roles and responsibilities of each organ of the Company.

The GMS is the highest organ in the corporate governance structure. The GMS is a company organ with an exclusive authority that cannot be delegated to other organs, as long as its roles and decisions are still in accordance with the Limited Liability Company Law and/or the Articles of Association of the Company. The GMS is a forum for shareholders to formulate important decisions by taking into account the interests of the Company, as well as considering the provisions in the Company's Articles of Association and all applicable rules and regulations.

Perseroan menyadari bahwa penerapan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik memiliki peran penting dalam mendukung akuntabilitas dan peningkatan keberhasilan usaha Perseroan. Adanya penerapan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik diharapkan juga dapat meningkatkan nilai Perseroan dan menciptakan citra yang baik dan unggul bagi Perseroan di masa akan datang. Oleh karenanya, Perseroan berkomitmen untuk menerapkan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik secara menyeluruh di dalam setiap aspek fungsi Perseroan dengan mengacu pada seluruh peraturan yang terkait.

Berdasarkan Undang-Undang No. 40 Tahun 2007 tentang Perseroan Terbatas sebagaimana telah diubah dengan Undang-Undang No. 6 Tahun 2023 tentang Cipta Kerja, mekanisme tata kelola perusahaan mengatur pola hubungan dan struktur antara organ utama Perseroan yang terdiri dari RUPS, Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan juga organ pendukung lainnya, yakni Komite Audit, Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi, Unit Audit Internal, dan Sekretaris Perusahaan.

Struktur ini ditetapkan guna memastikan pelaksanaan prinsip tata kelola perusahaan secara sistematis dengan ditentukannya secara jelas mengenai peran dan tanggung jawab masing-masing organ Perseroan.

RUPS merupakan organ tertinggi dalam struktur tata kelola Perseroan. RUPS menjadi organ perusahaan dengan kewenangan eksklusif yang tidak dapat dilimpahkan kepada organ lain, sepanjang peran dan keputusannya masih sesuai dengan Undang-Undang Perseroan Terbatas dan/atau Anggaran Dasar Perseroan. RUPS merupakan forum bagi para pemegang saham untuk memformulasikan keputusan-keputusan penting dengan memperhatikan kepentingan Perseroan, serta mempertimbangkan ketentuan-ketentuan dalam Anggaran Dasar Perseroan dan seluruh ketentuan dan peraturan yang berlaku.

Meanwhile, the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors are jointly responsible for the continuity of the Company's business in the long term. The management of the Company is carried out by the Board of Directors, while the Board of Commissioners is responsible for supervising the performance of the management of the Company conducted by the Board of Directors. Therefore, the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors must have a shared perception of the Company's vision, mission and values to be achieved.

The implementation of the tasks and responsibilities of the two organs are supported by their respective supporting organs. The Board of Commissioners is assisted by the Audit Committee, and the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Meanwhile, the Board of Directors is assisted by the Corporate Secretary and the Internal Audit Unit.

Sementara itu, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi secara bersama-sama bertanggung jawab atas kelangsungan usaha Perseroan dalam jangka panjang. Pengelolaan Perseroan dilakukan oleh Direksi, sementara Dewan Komisaris bertanggung jawab untuk melakukan pengawasan terhadap kinerja pengelolaan Perseroan oleh Direksi. Oleh karena itu, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi harus memiliki kesamaan persepsi terhadap visi, misi, dan nilai-nilai Perseroan yang ingin dicapai.

Pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab kedua organ tersebut didukung oleh organ pendukung masing-masing. Dewan Komisaris dibantu oleh Komite Audit dan Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi. Sedangkan Direksi dibantu oleh Sekretaris Perusahaan dan Unit Audit Internal.

# General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS)

## Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS)

The GMS is the primary mechanism to protect and exercise the rights of shareholders. As an organ of the Company, the GMS holds the ultimate authority over matters cannot be delegated to the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors. However, without diluting either the power or authority of the GMS, the GMS or shareholders may not intervene against the duties, functions, and authorities of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors which must be carried out in accordance with the Articles of Association and prevailing laws and regulations.

The GMS serves as a mechanism for shareholders to make important decisions regarding their investment in the Company, by observing provisions in the Articles of Association and all prevailing regulations.

In addition, in the event that the Company has a conflict of interest with the personal interests of all members of the Board of Directors and all members of the Board of Commissioners, the GMS will appoint a person or more who does not have a conflict of interest to represent the Company in carrying out the matter.

RUPS merupakan mekanisme utama untuk melindungi dan menggunakan hak-hak pemegang saham. Sebagai suatu organ Perseroan, RUPS memegang wewenang tertinggi atas hal-hal yang tidak dapat dilimpahkan kepada Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi. Namun tanpa mengurangi kekuasaan atau wewenang RUPS, RUPS atau pemegang saham tidak dapat melakukan intervensi terhadap tugas, fungsi, dan wewenang Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi yang harus dijalankan sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar dan hukum dan peraturan yang berlaku.

RUPS merupakan mekanisme bagi pemegang saham untuk mengambil keputusan penting terkait dengan penyertaannya di Perseroan, dengan memperhatikan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar dan semua peraturan yang berlaku.

Di samping itu, dalam hal Perseroan mempunyai benturan kepentingan dengan kepentingan pribadi seluruh anggota Direksi dan seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris, maka RUPS akan mengangkat seorang atau lebih yang tidak mempunyai benturan kepentingan tersebut, untuk mewakili Perseroan dalam menjalankan hal tersebut.

# Board of Commissioners

## Dewan Komisaris

The appointment and election of the Board of Commissioners have complied with the provisions of the Company's Articles of Association and applicable laws and regulations.

The Board of Commissioners is collectively responsible and has a duty to supervise and provide advice to the Board of Directors in managing the Company, including to ensure that the Company has implemented GCG at all organizational levels or hierarchy. In carrying out its duties, the Board of Commissioners is responsible to the GMS.

Collectively, the Board of Commissioners possesses the expertise to carry out its mandated responsibilities. The Board of Commissioners consists of member(s) who have adequate understanding of business dynamics, the competence to address emerging challenges, and the ability to make independent decisions that drive improvements in the Company's performance. In addition to this, members of the Board of Commissioners effectively review management performance and provide constructive feedback about management performance. All members uphold the highest standards of integrity and have outstanding reputations.

Pengangkatan dan pemilihan Dewan Komisaris telah memenuhi ketentuan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Dewan Komisaris bertanggung jawab secara kolektif dan bertugas mengawasi dan memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi dalam pengelolaan Perseroan, termasuk memastikan bahwa Perseroan telah menerapkan GCG pada semua jenjang atau hirarki organisasi. Dalam menjalankan tugasnya, Dewan Komisaris bertanggung jawab kepada RUPS.

Secara kolektif, Dewan Komisaris memiliki keahlian untuk melaksanakan tanggung jawab yang diamanatkan. Dewan Komisaris terdiri dari anggota yang memiliki pemahaman yang memadai mengenai dinamika bisnis, kompetensi untuk menangani permasalahan yang timbul dalam bisnis, mengatasi tantangan yang muncul, serta kemampuan untuk mengambil keputusan secara mandiri yang mendorong peningkatan kinerja Perseroan. Selain itu, anggota Dewan Komisaris dapat melakukan tinjauan kinerja manajemen secara efektif dan memberikan masukan yang membangun tentang kinerja manajemen. Seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris menjunjung standar integritas tertinggi dan memiliki reputasi yang unggul.
