# Duties and Responsibilities

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

The implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners are subject to the provisions stipulated in the Articles of Association and the prevailing laws and regulations.

The Board of Commissioners has the following duties and responsibilities:

1. Supervise and be responsible for the supervision of management policies and the course of management in general, both regarding the Company and the Company's business, and provide advice to the Board of Directors.
2. Issue the approval for the Company's annual work plan, at the latest before the commencement of the next Financial Year.
3. Perform tasks specifically assigned to the Board of Commissioners according to the Articles of Association, applicable laws and regulations and/or based on the decision of the General Meeting of Shareholders.
4. Perform its duties, authorities, and responsibilities in accordance with the provisions of the Articles of Association of the Company and the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders.
5. Examine and study the annual report prepared by the Board of Directors as well as sign the annual report.
6. Comply with the Articles of Association and laws and regulations, and uphold the principles of professionalism, efficiency, transparency, independency, accountability, responsibility, and fairness.
7. Represent the Company in the event that the Company has interests that conflict with the personal interest of all members of the Board of Directors (conflict of interest).
8. Establish the Audit Committee, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and other committees in accordance with the requirements stipulated in the laws and regulations in the capital market.
9. Ensure the implementation of all Company policies that have been prepared related to nomination and remuneration processes, performance evaluation, self assessment for members of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners, and the policies and criteria of succession/regeneration in the nomination of candidates of the Board of Directors and/or Board of Commissioners.
10. Establish policies and evaluate the Company's performance from a good, stable, growing and sustainable financial aspect.
11. Monitor the implementation of good corporate governance principles.

Pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris tunduk pada ketentuan yang diatur dalam Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Dewan Komisaris memiliki tugas dan tanggung jawab sebagai berikut:

1. Melakukan pengawasan dan bertanggung jawab atas pengawasan terhadap kebijakan pengurusan dan jalannya pengurusan pada umumnya, baik mengenai Perseroan maupun usaha Perseroan, dan memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi.
2. Memberikan persetujuan atas rencana kerja tahunan Perseroan, selambat-lambatnya sebelum dimulainya Tahun Buku yang akan datang.
3. Melakukan tugas yang secara khusus diberikan kepada Dewan Komisaris menurut Anggaran Dasar, peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan/atau berdasarkan keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham.
4. Melakukan tugas, wewenang, dan tanggung jawab sesuai dengan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan dan keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham.
5. Meneliti dan menelaah laporan tahunan yang dipersiapkan oleh Direksi serta menandatangani laporan tahunan tersebut.
6. Mematuhi Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundangan-undangan, serta wajib melaksanakan prinsip-prinsip profesionalisme, efisiensi, transparansi, kemandirian, akuntabilitas, pertanggungjawaban, serta kewajaran.
7. Mewakili Perseroan dalam hal Perseroan mempunyai kepentingan yang bertentangan dengan kepentingan pribadi seluruh anggota Direksi (benturan kepentingan).
8. Membentuk Komite Audit, Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi serta komite lainnya sesuai dengan persyaratan yang diatur dalam peraturan perundang-undangan di bidang pasar modal.
9. Memastikan dilaksanakannya segala kebijakan Perseroan yang telah disusun terkait dengan nominasi, remunerasi, evaluasi kinerja, penilaian sendiri (self assessment) bagi anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris, dan kebijakan dan kriteria suksesi/regenerasi dalam proses nominasi calon anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris.
10. Menetapkan kebijakan dan melakukan penilaian kinerja Perseroan dari aspek keuangan yang baik, stabil, bertumbuh dan berkelanjutan.
11. Melakukan pemantauan atas penerapan prinsip tata kelola perusahaan yang baik.

# Board of Commissioners Charter

## Piagam Dewan Komisaris

In supervising the Company's management, the Board of Commissioners follows the guidelines from the Board of Commissioners Charter which contains their duties, responsibilities, and authorities.

Dalam mengawasi pengelolaan Perseroan, Dewan Komisaris berpedoman pada Piagam Dewan Komisaris yang memuat tugas, tanggung jawab dan wewenang Dewan Komisaris.

# Performance Assessment of the Board of Directors

## Penilaian atas Kinerja Direksi

The Board of Commissioners highly appreciate the performance of the Board of Directors and all Company personnel for the positive performance achievements amidst various challenges faced. The Board of Commissioners considers that the Board of Directors has given its best efforts and strategies to maintain the stability and continuity of the Company's business.

The Board of Commissioners has conducted an assessment of the performance of the Board of Directors in managing the Company throughout the 2025 Financial Year. A comprehensive evaluation was carried out to assess the effectiveness of the Directors' leadership in steering the Company's strategy amid the dynamics of the highly competitive healthcare industry. The Board of Commissioners views that the Board of Directors has demonstrated strong leadership as well as consistent commitment to the Company's Vision and Objectives.

Under the leadership of the Board of Directors, the Company successfully recorded solid financial performance with consistent growth compared to the previous year. The Company closed the 2025 Financial Year with a net profit after tax of IDR 600.32 billion, representing an increase of 29.76% compared to IDR 462.65 billion in 2024. This improvement in performance was also accompanied by higher returns for shareholders. The Board of Commissioners views this achievement as a reflection of the Board of Directors' capability to formulate and implement effective strategies, manage risks prudently, and maintain operational efficiency.

In overseeing the formulation of strategy, the Board of Commissioners has reviewed and provided input on the Company's Annual Work Plan and Budget (RKAP) to ensure that the Company's strategic direction aligns with shareholders' aspirations, regulatory requirements, and long-term sustainability objectives. Through this process, the Board of Commissioners actively conveyed considerations related to innovation, risk management, and value creation, which were subsequently integrated into the Company's strategic agenda.

In overseeing the implementation of strategy, the Board of Commissioners carried out its role through structured and intensive engagement with the Board of Directors. Throughout the 2025 Financial Year, the Board of Commissioners consistently held internal meetings, joint meetings with the Board of Directors, as well as meetings with the Committees under the Board of Commissioners. These forums served as the primary platform for the Board of Commissioners to review periodic performance reports, discuss market dynamics and strategic priorities, and provide input and direction on business development, in-licensing programs, merger and acquisition opportunities, sustainability, human resources, compliance, internal audit, and financial performance.

Dewan Komisaris sangat mengapresiasi kinerja Direksi dan seluruh jajaran Perseroan atas pencapaian kinerja positif yang berhasil dicapai di tengah berbagai tantangan yang muncul. Dewan Komisaris menilai bahwa Direksi telah mengerahkan upaya dan strategi terbaik demi mempertahankan stabilitas dan kelangsungan bisnis Perseroan.

Dewan Komisaris telah melakukan penilaian atas kinerja Direksi dalam mengelola Perseroan sepanjang Tahun Buku 2025. Evaluasi menyeluruh dilakukan untuk menilai efektivitas kepemimpinan Direksi dalam mengarahkan strategi Perseroan di tengah dinamika pasar industri kesehatan yang kompetitif. Dewan Komisaris menilai bahwa Direksi menunjukkan kepemimpinan yang kuat sekaligus komitmen yang konsisten terhadap Visi dan Tujuan Perseroan.

Di bawah kepemimpinan Direksi, Perseroan berhasil mencatatkan kinerja keuangan yang solid dengan pertumbuhan yang konsisten dari tahun sebelumnya. Perseroan menutup tahun buku 2025 dengan laba bersih setelah pajak sebesar Rp 600,32 miliar, meningkat 29,76% dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya yaitu sebesar Rp 462,65 miliar pada tahun 2024. Peningkatan kinerja ini juga disertai dengan imbal hasil yang lebih baik kepada para pemegang saham. Dewan Komisaris memandang bahwa capaian tersebut mencerminkan kemampuan Direksi dalam merumuskan dan mengimplementasikan strategi yang efektif, mengelola risiko secara bijak, serta menjaga efisiensi operasional.

Dalam pengawasan atas perumusan strategi, Dewan Komisaris telah menelaah dan memberikan masukan terhadap Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Tahunan Perseroan (RKAP), guna memastikan arah strategis Perseroan sejalan dengan aspirasi pemegang saham, ketentuan regulator, serta tujuan keberlanjutan jangka panjang. Melalui proses ini, Dewan Komisaris secara aktif menyampaikan pertimbangan terkait inovasi, manajemen risiko, dan penciptaan nilai yang kemudian diintegrasikan ke dalam agenda strategis Perseroan.

Dalam pengawasan atas implementasi strategi, Dewan Komisaris melaksanakan fungsinya melalui keterlibatan yang terstruktur dan intensif dengan Direksi. Sepanjang Tahun Buku 2025, Dewan Komisaris secara konsisten menyelenggarakan rapat internal, rapat gabungan dengan Direksi, serta rapat bersama Komite-Komite di bawah Dewan Komisaris. Forum-forum ini menjadi sarana utama bagi Dewan Komisaris untuk menelaah laporan kinerja berkala, membahas dinamika pasar dan prioritas strategis, serta memberikan masukan dan arahan terkait pengembangan usaha, program in-licensing, peluang merger dan akuisisi, keberlanjutan, sumber daya manusia, kepatuhan, audit internal, dan kinerja keuangan.

Through these mechanisms, the Board of Commissioners ensured that the Company's strategies were implemented effectively and aligned with the Company's Vision. The Board of Commissioners also commended the Board of Directors' initiatives in expanding research and development activities, strengthening the distribution network, building collaborations through the ABGC (Academic, Business, Government, Community) framework, and advancing sustainability programs. These initiatives not only demonstrated operational effectiveness but also reflected a long-term orientation that strengthened the trust of patients, customers, and shareholders.

Melalui mekanisme tersebut, Dewan Komisaris memastikan strategi Perseroan dijalankan secara efektif dan selaras dengan Visi Perseroan. Dewan Komisaris juga mengapresiasi inisiatif Direksi dalam memperluas kegiatan penelitian dan pengembangan, memperkuat jaringan distribusi, membangun kolaborasi melalui keterhubungan ABGC (Academic, Business, Government, Community), serta mendorong program keberlanjutan. Langkah-langkah ini tidak hanya memperlihatkan efektivitas operasional, tetapi juga menunjukkan orientasi jangka panjang yang memperkuat kepercayaan pasien, pelanggan, serta pemegang saham.

# Assessment of the Performance of the Board of Commissioners

## Penilaian terhadap Kinerja Dewan Komisaris

Referring to the Board of Commissioners Charter, the evaluation of the performance of the members of the Board of Commissioners is carried out by the Company's shareholders. The Company has also established a Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Commissioners, which serves as a guideline for assessing the effectiveness of the implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners and also as a form of accountability for the performance assessment of the Board of Commissioners of the Company.

The Company's shareholders periodically evaluate the performance of the Board of Commissioners at least once a year. This evaluation assesses the Board of Commissioners' effectiveness in supervising and managing the Company as stated in the prevailing laws and regulations and the Company's Articles of Association.

In addition, based on the Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Commissioners, the following are the provisions for the Board of Commissioners performance assessment:

1. Performance appraisal of the Board of Commissioners is performed using a self-assessment method every year collegially.
2. Performance appraisal of each member of the Board of Commissioners is performed by the President Commissioner every year based on the role and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners.
3. Each member of the Board of Commissioners conducts a self-assessment, to which then the results are consolidated for a joint review by all members of the Board of Commissioners in order to determine the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners and the areas that need improvement.
4. The Board of Commissioners prepares the corrective actions, and the President Commissioner ensures the implementation of the corrective actions.
5. Performance appraisal of the Board of Commissioners is conducted by considering several components, which include the structure and composition of the Board of Commissioners, strategy implementation and company management, the effectiveness of the committee, risk management implementation and internal control, and the implementation of Good Corporate Governance.

Mengacu pada Piagam Dewan Komisaris, penilaian atas kinerja anggota Dewan Komisaris dilakukan oleh pemegang saham Perseroan. Perseroan juga telah menetapkan Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris, yang bertindak sebagai pedoman dalam menilai efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris dan juga sebagai bentuk akuntabilitas atas penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris Perseroan.

Pemegang saham Perseroan secara berkala melakukan evaluasi atas kinerja Dewan Komisaris setidaknya satu kali dalam setahun. Evaluasi ini menilai efektivitas Dewan Komisaris dalam melakukan pengawasan dan pengurusan Perseroan sebagaimana yang tercantum dalam peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan.

Di samping itu, berdasarkan Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris, maka di bawah ini merupakan ketentuan atas penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris:

1. Penilaian Kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilakukan dengan metode self-assessment setiap tahun secara kolegial.
2. Penilaian kinerja Anggota Dewan Komisaris dilakukan oleh Presiden Komisaris setiap tahun berdasarkan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris.
3. Masing-masing anggota Dewan Komisaris melakukan self-assessment, kemudian hasilnya dikonsolidasi untuk ditinjau bersama oleh seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris guna menetapkan efektivitas dari Dewan Komisaris beserta area-area yang perlu dilakukan perbaikan.
4. Dewan Komisaris menyusun rencana tindak lanjut perbaikan dan Presiden Komisaris memastikan pelaksanaan rencana perbaikan tersebut.
5. Penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilakukan dengan mempertimbangkan beberapa komponen, antara lain: struktur dan komposisi Dewan Komisaris, pelaksanaan strategi dan pengelolaan perusahaan, efektivitas pelaksanaan program kerja komite, penerapan manajemen risiko dan pengendalian internal, serta penerapan prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik.

The Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Commissioners also regulates the aspects of the Board of Commissioners' assessment. These aspects of the assessment are among others:

1. Supervise the management of the Company performed by the Board of Directors.
2. Review, examine, and approve the Annual Work Plan of the Company.
3. Carry out special tasks assigned to the member(s) of the Board of Commissioners in accordance with the Articles of Association, prevailing laws and regulations and/or resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders.
4. Perform his/ her duties and responsibilities in accordance with the provisions of the Articles of Association and the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders.
5. Comply with the Articles of the Association and the prevailing laws and regulations and be obliged to perform duties based on principles of professionalism, efficiency, transparency, independence, accountability, responsibility and fairness, among others to convey the BOC meeting in accordance with the applicable regulations.

Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris juga mengatur perihal aspek-aspek penilaian Dewan Komisaris. Aspek-aspek penilaian tersebut antara lain:

1. Mengawasi pengurusan Perseroan yang dilaksanakan oleh Direksi.
2. Meninjau, memeriksa, dan menyetujui Rencana Kerja Tahunan Perseroan.
3. Melakukan tugas khusus yang diberikan kepada anggota Dewan Komisaris sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar, hukum dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan/atau keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham.
4. Melakukan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya sesuai dengan ketentuan-ketentuan Anggaran Dasar dan keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham.
5. Mematuhi Anggaran Dasar serta hukum dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan wajib melaksanakan tugasnya sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip profesionalisme, efisiensi, transparansi, independensi, akuntabilitas, pertanggungjawaban dan kewajaran, antara lain melaksanakan Rapat Dewan Komisaris sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.

# View on the Implementation of the Company's Corporate Governance

## Pandangan atas penerapan tata Kelola Perseroan

The Company affirms that strong corporate governance is a fundamental foundation for safeguarding performance, reputation, and long-term sustainability. The principles of Good Corporate Governance (GCG) are implemented through transparency, accountability, responsibility, independence, and fairness. Through the consistent application of these principles, strategic decision-making across the organization is carried out in a consistent and equitable manner and aligned with the interests of shareholders and other stakeholders.

Throughout the 2025 Financial Year, the Board of Commissioners is of the view that the Company has consistently implemented these governance principles. Transparency is realized through the timely and accurate disclosure of information in the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, Corporate Governance Report, as well as periodic financial reporting. Accountability is strengthened through a clear organizational structure, well-defined roles and responsibilities, and a system of checks and balances supported by independent external audits. Responsibility is reflected in compliance with prevailing laws and regulations, sound management practices, and the fulfillment of social and environmental responsibilities. Independence is maintained through objective decision-making processes free from conflicts of interest, while fairness is manifested through the protection of shareholders' rights (including minority shareholders), equal treatment of all stakeholders, and enhanced employee engagement through annual surveys.

The implementation of such governance practices is also supported by the active roles of the Company's supporting organs. The Audit Committee as well as the Nomination and Remuneration Committee assist the Board of Commissioners in carrying out its supervisory functions, while the Corporate Secretary and the Internal Audit Unit support the Board of Directors in the execution of management functions. The Board of Commissioners is of the view that this governance framework has operated effectively throughout the 2025 Financial Year in safeguarding accountability, compliance, and stakeholder trust.

Perseroan menegaskan bahwa tata kelola perusahaan yang kuat merupakan fondasi utama dalam menjaga kinerja, reputasi, dan keberlanjutan jangka panjang. Prinsip Good Corporate Governance (GCG) dijalankan melalui transparansi, akuntabilitas, responsibilitas, independensi, dan kewajaran (fairness). Dengan penerapan prinsip-prinsip tersebut, pengambilan keputusan strategis di seluruh organisasi dijalankan secara konsisten, adil, serta selaras dengan kepentingan pemegang saham dan pemangku kepentingan lainnya.

Sepanjang Tahun Buku 2025, Dewan Komisaris berpendapat bahwa Perseroan telah secara konsisten menerapkan prinsip-prinsip tata kelola tersebut. Transparansi diwujudkan melalui keterbukaan informasi yang tepat waktu dan akurat dalam Laporan Tahunan, Laporan Keberlanjutan, Laporan Tata Kelola Perusahaan, serta pelaporan keuangan secara berkala. Akuntabilitas diperkuat melalui struktur organisasi yang jelas, pembagian peran yang terdefinisi, serta mekanisme check and balance yang didukung oleh audit eksternal independen. Responsibilitas tercermin dalam kepatuhan terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan, praktik manajemen yang sehat, serta pelaksanaan tanggung jawab sosial kepada masyarakat dan lingkungan. Independensi dijaga melalui proses pengambilan keputusan yang objektif dan bebas dari benturan kepentingan, sementara kewajaran diwujudkan melalui perlindungan hak-hak pemegang saham (termasuk pemegang saham minoritas), perlakuan setara terhadap seluruh pemangku kepentingan, serta peningkatan keterikatan karyawan melalui survei tahunan.

Penerapan tata kelola tersebut juga didukung oleh peran aktif organ pendukung Perseroan. Komite Audit serta Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi yang membantu Dewan Komisaris dalam menjalankan fungsi pengawasan, sementara Sekretaris Perusahaan dan Unit Audit Internal mendukung Direksi dalam pelaksanaan fungsi pengelolaan. Dewan Komisaris menilai bahwa kerangka tata kelola ini telah berfungsi secara efektif sepanjang Tahun Buku 2025 dalam menjaga akuntabilitas, kepatuhan, dan kepercayaan pemangku kepentingan.

# Board of Directors

## Direksi

The Board of Directors' responsibility in corporate management is aimed at creating added value and ensuring business continuity. The Board of Directors is in charge and responsible collectively for managing the Company. Each Director performs his/her duties and makes decisions in accordance with the division of duties and authorities. Duties and other matters related to the Board of Directors must be in accordance with the Articles of Association and prevailing laws and regulations.

The Board of Directors is one of the Company's main organs that holds full responsibility for corporate management in accordance with the Articles of Association. In conducting its duties, the Board of Directors is responsible to the GMS. This responsibility is a manifestation of corporate management accountability in the implementation of GCG principles.

Each member of the Board of Directors may perform their decision-making duty under the segregation of duties and authorities of the Board of Directors. However, the performance of duties of each member of the Board of Directors remains a collective responsibility. The President Director has to coordinate the activities of the Board of Directors.

Tanggung jawab Direksi dalam pengelolaan perusahaan ditujukan untuk menciptakan nilai tambah dan memastikan kelangsungan bisnis. Direksi bertugas dan bertanggung jawab secara kolektif untuk mengelola Perseroan. Setiap Direktur menjalankan tugasnya dan mengambil keputusan sesuai dengan pembagian tugas dan wewenangnya. Tugas dan hal-hal lain yang berkaitan dengan Direksi harus sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Direksi adalah salah satu organ utama Perseroan yang memegang tanggung jawab penuh atas pengurusan perseroan sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar. Dalam menjalankan tugasnya, Direksi bertanggung jawab kepada RUPS. Tanggung jawab tersebut merupakan wujud akuntabilitas manajemen perusahaan dalam penerapan prinsip-prinsip GCG.

Masing-masing anggota Direksi dapat melaksanakan tugas pengambilan keputusan sesuai dengan pembagian tugas dan wewenangnya, namun pelaksanaan tugas oleh masing-masing anggota Direksi tetap merupakan tanggung jawab bersama. Tugas Direktur Utama adalah mengkoordinasikan seluruh kegiatan Direksi.

# Duties and Authorities of the Board of Directors

## Tugas dan Wewenang Direksi

The implementation of the duties and authorities of the Board of Directors are subject to the provisions stipulated in the Articles of Association and the prevailing laws and regulations.

The Board of Directors has the duties and responsibilities in accordance with the Articles of Association of the Company as follows:

1. The Board of Directors is in charge of carrying out and being responsible for the management of the Company in all aspects, and for the best interests of the Company in accordance with the purposes and objectives of the Company as stipulated in the Articles of Association. In carrying out the duties and responsibilities of managing the Company, the Board of Directors is supervised by the Board of Commissioners.
2. In carrying out the duties and responsibilities for management, the Board of Directors is required to hold an Annual GMS and other GMS as stipulated in the laws and regulations and the Articles of Association and submit the accountability report on its management to the Shareholders through such GMS.
3. Each member of the Board of Directors must carry out their duties and responsibilities in good faith, full of responsibility and prudence.
4. The Board of Directors is obliged to secure, manage and strive to improve the Company's valuable assets.
5. The Board of Directors has the right to represent the Company inside and outside the Court on all matters and in all events, bind the Company to other parties and other parties to the Company, and carry out all actions regarding decision and ownership, but with the limitation that for certain matters, the Board of Directors must obtain prior approval from the Company's Board of Commissioners, namely:

Pelaksanaan tugas dan wewenang Direksi tunduk pada ketentuan yang diatur dalam Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Direksi memiliki tugas dan wewenang Direksi sesuai Anggaran Dasar Perseroan yakni sebagai berikut:

1. Direksi bertugas menjalankan dan bertanggung jawab atas pengurusan Perseroan di segala aspek, dan untuk kepentingan terbaik Perseroan sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuan Perseroan yang ditetapkan dalam Anggaran Dasar. Dalam menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawab atas pengurusan Perseroan, Direksi diawasi oleh Dewan Komisaris.
2. Direksi wajib menyelenggarakan RUPS Tahunan dan RUPS lainnya sebagaimana diatur dalam peraturan perundang-undangan dan Anggaran Dasar, dan menyampaikan laporan pertanggungjawaban atas pengurusannya kepada para Pemegang Saham melalui RUPS tersebut.
3. Setiap anggota Direksi wajib melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya dengan itikad baik, penuh tanggung jawab, dan kehati-hatian.
4. Direksi wajib mengamankan, mengelola, dan berupaya meningkatkan aset-aset berharga Perseroan.
5. Direksi berhak mewakili Perseroan di dalam dan di luar Pengadilan tentang segala hal dan dalam segala kejadian, mengikat Perseroan dengan pihak lain dan pihak lain dengan Perseroan, serta menjalankan segala tindakan baik yang mengenai kepengurusan maupun kepemilikan, akan tetapi dengan pembatasan bahwa untuk hal-hal tertentu, Direksi harus memperoleh persetujuan terlebih dahulu dari Dewan Komisaris Perseroan, yakni:

a. borrowing or lending money on behalf of the Company (excluding withdrawing the Company's money from the banks) which amount is in excess of the limit as determined by the Board of Commissioners from time to time;
b. establishing a business entity or participating in other companies, both in Indonesia or outside Indonesia;
c. binding the Company as guarantor; and
d. purchase or dispose of the Company's assets for a value equal to or above 50% (fifty percent) of the Company's total equity.

However, the involvement of the Board of Commissioners does not negate the responsibility of the Board of Directors for the management of the Company.

6. The Board of Directors must meet the requirements specified in the Capital Market regulations in carrying out actions that constitute material transactions and/or conflicts of interest as referred to in the applicable Capital Market regulations.
7. Members of the Board of Directors are not authorized to represent the Company if there is a case in court between the Company and the member of the Board of Directors concerned.
8. If something happens where the interests of the Company conflict with the personal interests of a member of the Board of Directors (conflict of interest), the Company will be represented by another member of the Board of Directors who does not have a conflict of interest. In the event that the Company has interests that conflict with personal interests of all members of the Board of Directors (conflict of interest), then the Company will be represented by the Board of Commissioners.

When the Company suffers a loss, each member of the Board of Directors is jointly and severally responsible for the Company's losses caused by the mistakes or negligence of members of the Board of Directors in carrying out their duties. However, member(s) of the Board of Directors are not required to fulfill these responsibilities if he/she can prove the following:

a. The loss was not due to his/her fault or negligence;
b. He/she has conducted management in good faith, full of responsibility and prudence for the benefit of the Company and in accordance with the aims and objectives of the Company;
c. He/she has no conflict of interest, either directly or indirectly, for the management actions that resulted in the loss; and
d. He/she has taken action to prevent the loss or the continuation of the loss.

Further, members of the Board of Directors shall, in performing their duties and responsibilities, be required to comply with the Code of Conducts of the Company and are prohibited from taking personal advantages, both directly and indirectly, from the Company's activities other than salaries and other benefits which they are legally entitled to, including the retirement benefits they receive as members of Board of Directors in accordance with the prevailing laws and regulations. The President Director is obliged to ensure compliance of all members of the Board of Directors with the Code of Conduct of the Company, including settling any conflicts that may arise.

# The Role of the Board of Directors in Formulating Corporate Strategy and Strategic Policies

Peran Direksi dalam Perumusan Strategi dan Kebijakan Strategi Perseroan

The Board of Directors plays a central role in formulating the Company's strategic direction and policies, which serve as the primary guidelines for all business activities. Each year, the strategy-formulation process begins with the preparation of the Company's Annual Work Plan and Budget (RKAP), which translates the Company's long-term aspirations into measurable programs and targets. In this process, the Board of Directors is responsible for identifying growth opportunities, anticipating market dynamics, and establishing strategic priorities that align with shareholder expectations. Furthermore, the Board of Directors ensures that the principles of sustainability and innovation are embedded in every strategic policy, so that the Company's growth is not only focused on financial performance but also on creating long-term value for patients, customers, and other stakeholders.

Throughout the 2025 Financial Year, the Company's strategy was formulated based on three key pillars. First, strengthening the core business and the Company's portfolio of leading brands to ensure they remain the primary drivers of growth. Second, fostering innovation through continuous investment in research, the launch of new products, and the development of product licensing collaborations with strategic partners to meet the evolving healthcare needs. Third, enhancing operational efficiency through cost discipline, digitalization initiatives, and the reinforcement of the national distribution network.

These three pillars were then translated into specific strategies for each business segment, namely:

- Consumer Health, focusing on enhancing brand awareness, driving new product innovation, expanding healthcare professional reach, increasing penetration in hospitals and clinics, expanding distribution coverage, and strengthening e-commerce channels the retail sector, particularly pharmacies.
- Distribution, through PT Parit Padang Global (PPG), by implementing direct and sub-distributor expansion strategies, digitalizing the supply chain, and adding new principals.
- Alliance (Licensing), through portfolio renewal, accelerated product registration processes, and exploration of strategic partnership opportunities to expand capabilities and product offerings.
- International Business, by strengthening the commercialization of innovative products through existing distributors and exploring new market partnerships.

Furthermore, the Board of Directors, both individually and together with the President Director, is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and monitoring the Company's short-term and long-term business strategies. These responsibilities include strategic planning, business development, marketing strategy, sales functions, and managing relationships with external stakeholders. The Board of Directors also conducts continuous performance monitoring, reviews the effectiveness of strategy implementation, and ensures that all initiatives are aligned with good corporate governance (GCG) principles and applicable policies.

Direksi memegang peran sentral dalam merumuskan arah strategis dan kebijakan Perseroan yang menjadi pedoman utama bagi seluruh kegiatan usaha. Setiap tahun, proses perumusan strategi diawali melalui penyusunan Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Perseroan (RKAP) yang menerjemahkan aspirasi jangka panjang perusahaan ke dalam program kerja dan target yang terukur. Dalam perumusan ini, Direksi bertanggung jawab untuk mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan, mengantisipasi dinamika pasar, serta menetapkan prioritas yang selaras dengan harapan pemegang saham. Selain itu, Direksi menanamkan prinsip keberlanjutan dan inovasi ke dalam setiap kebijakan strategis agar pertumbuhan Perseroan tidak hanya berorientasi pada kinerja finansial tetapi juga pada penciptaan nilai jangka panjang bagi pasien, pelanggan, dan pemangku kepentingan lainnya.

Sepanjang Tahun Buku 2025, strategi Perseroan dirumuskan berdasarkan tiga pilar utama. Pertama, memperkuat bisnis inti dan portofolio merek unggulan Perseroan agar tetap menjadi penggerak utama pertumbuhan. Kedua, mendorong inovasi melalui investasi berkelanjutan dalam riset dan pengembangan, peluncuran produk baru, serta pengembangan kerja sama lisensi produk dengan mitra strategis guna memenuhi kebutuhan kesehatan yang terus berkembang. Ketiga, meningkatkan efisiensi operasional melalui disiplin biaya, digitalisasi, serta penguatan jaringan distribusi nasional.

Ketiga pilar tersebut kemudian diturunkan ke dalam strategi spesifik pada masing-masing segmen usaha, yaitu:

- Consumer Health, dengan fokus pada peningkatan brand awareness, inovasi produk baru, perluasan jangkauan tenaga kesehatan, peningkatan penetrasi di rumah sakit dan klinik, penguatan, perluasan distribusi, dan penguatan kanal e-commerce serta sektor ritel khususnya apotek.
- Distribusi, melalui PT Parit Padang Global (PPG), dengan strategi ekspansi distribusi langsung dan sub-distributor, digitalisasi rantai pasok, serta penambahan prinsipal baru.
- Alliance (Licensing), melalui pembaruan portofolio transaksi, percepatan proses pendaftaran produk, serta eksplorasi peluang kemitraan strategis untuk memperluas kapabilitas dan portofolio produk.
- International Business, dengan memperkuat komersialisasi produk inovatif melalui distributor yang ada serta menjajaki kerja sama di negara baru.

Lebih lanjut, Direksi, baik secara individual maupun bersama dengan Presiden Direktur, bertanggung jawab untuk merancang, mengembangkan, melaksanakan, serta memantau strategi bisnis jangka pendek dan jangka panjang Perseroan. Tanggung jawab ini mencakup perencanaan strategis, pengembangan bisnis, strategi pemasaran, fungsi penjualan, serta hubungan dengan pemangku kepentingan eksternal. Direksi juga melakukan pemantauan kinerja secara berkesinambungan, meninjau efektivitas implementasi strategi, serta memastikan seluruh inisiatif selaras dengan tata kelola yang baik (GCG) dan kebijakan yang berlaku.

# The Process undertaken by the Board of Directors to ensure the Implementation of the Company's Strategy

Proses yang dilakukan Direksi untuk Memastikan Implementasi Strategi Perseroan

To ensure that the strategies formulated can be executed consistently and effectively, the Board of Directors implements structured control and monitoring mechanisms. The strategies and policies outlined in the Company's Annual Work Plan and Budget (RKAP) are further translated into detailed work programs at the divisional and operational levels, each equipped with clear performance indicators. The achievement of these programs is measured through the Personal Scorecards of each member of the Board of Directors, which include key performance indicators aligned with the Company's objectives.

The Board of Directors conducts regular monthly reviews of financial and operational results, as well as quarterly evaluations of strategic priority achievements. The evaluation results are discussed collegially to assess alignment between strategy and realization, while also determining corrective actions in the event of any deviation. In addition, the internal audit and risk management functions provide independent assessments to ensure that strategy implementation remains consistent with established policies and complies with prevailing laws and regulations.

The strategy implementation process also includes annual business strategy reviews, continuous monitoring and tracking of the Company's performance, strategic analyses, and the execution of business development initiatives. The Board of Directors, both individually and in collaboration with the President Director, works together to ensure that the established strategies are executed consistently across all key functions, including finance, operations, marketing, and business development.

Furthermore, the Board of Directors maintains ongoing communication with stakeholders—including employees, business partners, healthcare professionals, and regulators—to ensure that the adopted strategies are implemented comprehensively throughout the organization. Going forward, the Company will provide a more comprehensive description of this matter in the Board of Directors' Report in the next Annual Report period.

Untuk memastikan strategi yang telah dirumuskan dapat dijalankan secara konsisten dan efektif, Direksi menerapkan mekanisme pengendalian dan pemantauan yang terstruktur. Strategi dan kebijakan yang dituangkan dalam RKAP dijabarkan ke dalam program kerja rinci di tingkat divisi dan operasional, masing-masing dilengkapi dengan indikator kinerja yang jelas. Pencapaian program tersebut diukur menggunakan Personal Scorecard masing-masing anggota Direksi, yang memuat indikator kinerja utama sesuai dengan sasaran Perseroan.

Direksi secara rutin melakukan tinjauan bulanan atas hasil keuangan dan operasional serta evaluasi triwulanan terhadap pencapaian prioritas strategis. Hasil evaluasi dibahas secara kolegial untuk menilai kesesuaian antara strategi dan realisasi, sekaligus menetapkan langkah korektif bila terdapat deviasi. Selain itu, fungsi audit internal dan manajemen risiko memberikan penilaian independen guna memastikan pelaksanaan strategi tetap konsisten dengan kebijakan yang telah ditetapkan serta sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan.

Proses implementasi strategi juga dilakukan melalui tinjauan tahunan strategi bisnis, pemantauan dan pelacakan kinerja Perseroan, analisis strategis, serta pelaksanaan inisiatif pengembangan bisnis. Direksi, baik secara individu maupun bersama Presiden Direktur, berkolaborasi untuk memastikan strategi yang ditetapkan terlaksana secara konsisten di seluruh fungsi utama, meliputi keuangan, operasional, pemasaran, maupun pengembangan bisnis.

Selain itu, Direksi juga menjaga komunikasi berkelanjutan dengan para pemangku kepentingan, termasuk karyawan, mitra usaha, tenaga kesehatan, dan regulator, untuk memastikan bahwa strategi yang ditetapkan dapat terimplementasi secara menyeluruh di seluruh organisasi. Ke depannya, Perseroan akan menyampaikan uraian yang lebih komprehensif mengenai hal ini dalam Laporan Direksi pada Laporan Tahunan periode berikutnya.

# Board of Directors Charter

## Piagam Direksi

In managing the Company, the Board of Directors follows the guidelines from the Board of Directors Charter as inaugurated on June 9, 2015, which contains the work guidelines and rules, authority, duties, responsibilities, obligations, division of tasks, meetings, provisions on conflicts of interest, share ownership, mechanism arrangements and division of labor between members of the Board of Directors that are not regulated in the Company's Articles of Association or applicable laws and regulations. # Assessment of the Performance of the Board of Directors

## Penilaian terhadap Kinerja Direksi

The evaluation of the performance of the members of the Board of Directors is carried out by the Board of Commissioners and shareholders of the Company with reference to the Board of Directors Charter. The Company also has a Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Directors, which serves as a guideline for assessing the effectiveness of the implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Directors and also as a form of accountability for the performance assessment of the Board of Directors of the Company.

The Board of Directors Charter contains an explanation of the method for evaluating the performance of members of the Board of Directors, which includes the following:

1. The Board of Commissioners will determine the Key Performance Indicators (KPI);
2. The Board of Commissioners will evaluate the performance achievements of the members of the Board of Directors which will then be submitted to the shareholders at the GMS;
3. The performance evaluation of the members of the Board of Directors will be carried out based on the following KPIs:
- Achievement of the Board of Directors' performance (collectively) by looking at the Company's achievements based on the Business Plan and Annual Operational Plan, and/or other criteria determined by the Board of Commissioners.
- Achievement of the performance of the Board of Directors (individually) in achieving the Company's performance as stated in the Business Plan and Annual Operational Plan, Management Contract, and/or other criteria determined in the Board of Commissioners meeting.
- Implementation of GCG principles, both individually and collectively.

Penilaian atas kinerja anggota Direksi dilakukan oleh Dewan Komisaris dan pemegang saham Perseroan dengan mengacu pada Piagam Direksi. Perseroan juga telah memiliki Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Direksi, yang mana kebijakan ini disusun sebagai pedoman untuk menilai efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Direksi dan juga sebagai bentuk akuntabilitas atas penilaian kinerja Direksi Perseroan.

Piagam Direksi memuat penjelasan mengenai metode evaluasi/penilaian kinerja atas anggota Direksi, yang mana di antaranya adalah sebagai berikut:

1. Dewan Komisaris akan menetapkan Indikator Kinerja Utama/ Key Performance Indicator (KPI);
2. Dewan Komisaris akan melakukan evaluasi atas pencapaian kinerja dari anggota Direksi yang mana selanjutnya akan disampaikan pada pemegang saham dalam RUPS;
3. Evaluasi kinerja anggota Direksi tersebut akan dilakukan berdasarkan KPI sebagai berikut:
- Pencapaian kinerja Direksi (secara bersama-sama) dengan melihat pencapaian Perseroan berdasarkan Rencana Bisnis dan Rencana Operasional Tahunan, dan/atau kriteria lainnya yang ditetapkan oleh Dewan Komisaris.
- Pencapaian kinerja Direksi (secara individu) dalam mencapai kinerja Perseroan sebagaimana tercantum dalam Rencana Bisnis dan Rencana Operasional Tahunan, Kontrak Manajemen, dan/atau kriteria lainnya yang ditetapkan dalam rapat Dewan Komisaris.
- Implementasi prinsip-prinsip GCG, baik secara individu maupun kolektif.

# Audit Committee

## Komite Audit

The Company formed the Audit Committee with the aim of assisting the Board of Commissioners in carrying out oversight functions. The Audit Committee is tasked to ensure that the Company is managed with sound management in accordance with GCG principles and applicable laws and regulations. In addition, the Audit Committee is required to provide advice to the Board of Commissioners regarding the implementation of internal control and company audits, make a written report on each special assignment mandated by the Board of Commissioners, and make reports on the implementation of each audit activity carried out by the Audit Committee in the Company and its subsidiaries, including the level of achievement of the performance of the Audit Committee. The activities and performance of the Audit Committee must be disclosed in the Company's Annual Report.

The Company's Audit Committee is appointed based on the decision of the Board of Commissioners and responsible to the Board of Commissioners in assisting and carrying out the duties and functions of the Board of Commissioners.

Perseroan membentuk Komite Audit dengan tujuan untuk membantu Dewan Komisaris dalam melaksanakan fungsi pengawasan. Komite Audit bertugas untuk memastikan Perseroan dikelola dengan manajemen yang sehat sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip GCG dan peraturan perundangan yang berlaku. Selain itu, Komite Audit wajib memberikan nasihat kepada Dewan Komisaris sehubungan dengan pelaksanaan pengendalian internal dan audit perusahaan, membuat laporan secara tertulis atas setiap penugasan khusus yang diamanatkan oleh Dewan Komisaris, serta membuat laporan pelaksanaan atas setiap kegiatan audit yang dilakukan oleh Komite Audit pada Perseroan dan entitas anaknya, termasuk juga tingkat pencapaian kinerja Komite Audit. Kegiatan dan kinerja Komite Audit wajib diungkapkan dalam Laporan Tahunan Perseroan.

Komite Audit Perseroan diangkat berdasarkan keputusan Dewan Komisaris dan bertanggung jawab kepada Dewan Komisaris dalam membantu dan melaksanakan tugas dan fungsi Dewan Komisaris.

# Nomination and Remuneration Committee

## Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee is a committee that is established to support the implementation of the duties of the Board of Commissioners which is appointed based on the decision of the Board of Commissioners and responsible to the Board of Commissioners and shall act independently in carrying out its duties and responsibilities.

The establishment of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee refers to the Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 34/POJK.04/2015 on the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of Issuers or Public Companies. With the existence of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Company wishes that the process of selecting and making remuneration policies can be carried out in accordance with professional and independent considerations, is honest and fair, and without any pressure from any party.

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi merupakan komite yang mendukung pelaksanaan tugas Dewan Komisaris yang diangkat berdasarkan keputusan Dewan Komisaris dan bertanggung jawab kepada Dewan Komisaris serta wajib bertindak secara independen dalam melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya.

Pembentukan Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi mengacu pada Peraturan OJK No. 34/POJK.04/2015 tentang Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi Emiten atau Perusahaan Publik. Dengan adanya Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi, Perseroan berharap proses seleksi dan pengambilan kebijakan remunerasi dapat dilakukan sesuai dengan pertimbangan profesional dan independen, bersifat jujur dan adil, serta tanpa ada tekanan pihak manapun.

# Duties and Responsibilities

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee reports directly to the Board of Commissioners.

The scope of duties and responsibilities of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee are as follows:

1. In relation to the Nomination function:

a. Provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding:

(1) Composition of positions of members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners;
(2) Policies and criteria required in the nomination process; and
(3) Performance evaluation policy for members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners;

b. Assist the Board of Commissioners in assessing the performance of members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners based on benchmarks that have been prepared as evaluation materials;
c. Provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding capability development programs for members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners; and
d. Provide proposals of candidates who meet the requirements as members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners, to the Board of Commissioners to be submitted further to the GMS.

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Dewan Komisaris.

Lingkup tugas dan tanggung Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi adalah sebagai berikut:

1. Terkait dengan fungsi Nominasi:

a. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai:

(1) Komposisi jabatan anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris;
(2) Kebijakan dan kriteria yang dibutuhkan dalam proses nominasi; dan
(3) Kebijakan evaluasi kinerja bagi anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris;

b. Membantu Dewan Komisaris melakukan penilaian kinerja anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris berdasarkan tolak ukur yang telah disusun sebagai bahan evaluasi;
c. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai program pengembangan kemampuan anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris; dan
d. Memberikan usulan calon yang memenuhi syarat sebagai anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris, kepada Dewan Komisaris untuk disampaikan lebih lanjut kepada RUPS.

2. In relation to the Remuneration function:
a. Provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding:
(1) Remuneration structure;
(2) Remuneration policy; and
(3) Remuneration amount.
b. Assist the Board of Commissioners in assessing performance according to the remuneration received by each member of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners.

3. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee must act independently in carrying out its duties.

2. Terkait dengan fungsi Remunerasi:
a. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai:
(1) Struktur remunerasi;
(2) Kebijakan atas remunerasi; dan
(3) Besaran atas remunerasi.
b. Membantu Dewan Komisaris melakukan penilaian kinerja dengan kesesuaian remunerasi yang diterima masing-masing anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris.

3. Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi wajib bertindak independen dalam melaksanakan tugasnya.

# Internal Audit Unit

## Unit Audit Internal

The Internal Audit Unit was formed based on the Decree of the Board of Directors Number 05/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 regarding the Establishment of the Company's Internal Audit Unit dated June 19, 2020.

The Internal Audit Unit is a supporting division to the Board of Directors that is responsible for monitoring and evaluating internal controls, as well as providing independent and objective assurance and consultations to create added value and improve operational performance.

The Internal Audit Unit is responsible to the President Director and acts independently in carrying out its duties and responsibilities. The Internal Audit Unit has unrestricted access to all functions and records within the Company to fully carry out its mandate.

Mr. Devy Heriyanto was appointed as the Head of the Company's Internal Audit Unit as of February 21, 2025, replacing Mr. Patrick Lian Abuan Go, based on the Company's Board of Directors Decree Number 01/SK-DIR/SOHO/II/2025.

The complete biography of the Head of Internal Audit Unit can be seen in the Company Profile section.

Unit Audit Internal dibentuk berdasarkan Keputusan Direksi Perseroan Nomor 05/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 tentang Pembentukan Unit Audit Internal Perseroan tertanggal 19 Juni 2020.

Unit Audit Internal merupakan divisi pendukung dari Direksi yang bertanggung jawab untuk melaksanakan pemantauan dan evaluasi atas pengendalian internal, serta memberikan keyakinan dan konsultasi yang bersifat independen dan objektif guna meningkatkan nilai tambah dan kinerja operasional.

Unit Audit Internal bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden Direktur dan bertindak secara independen dalam melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya. Unit Audit Internal memiliki akses tidak terbatas ke semua fungsi dan catatan di dalam Perseroan, agar dapat menjalankan amanatnya secara penuh.

Sdr. Devy Heriyanto ditunjuk sebagai Kepala Unit Audit Internal Perseroan per 21 Februari 2025 menggantikan Sdr. Patrick Lian Abuan Go, berdasarkan Surat Keputusan Direksi Perseroan Nomor 01/SK-DIR/SOHO/II/2025.

Profil lengkap Kepala Unit Audit Internal dapat dilihat di bagian Profil Perusahaan.

# Duties and Responsibilities

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

The Internal Audit Unit reports directly to the President Director, the Board of Directors, the Board of Commissioners and the Audit Committee. The Internal Audit Unit is an independent unit within the Company.

The scope of duties and responsibilities of the Internal Audit Unit are as follows:

a. Prepare and implement annual Internal Audit plans;
b. Test and evaluate the implementation of internal control and management system in accordance with Company policy;
c. Examine and assess the efficiency and effectiveness of finance, accounting, operations, human resources, marketing, information technology and other activities;

Unit Audit Internal bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Presiden Direktur, Direksi, Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Audit. Unit Audit Internal adalah unit yang bersifat independen di dalam Perseroan.

Ruang Lingkup tugas dan tanggung jawab Unit Audit Internal adalah sebagai berikut:

a. Menyusun dan melaksanakan rencana Audit Internal tahunan;
b. Menguji dan mengevaluasi pelaksanaan pengendalian internal dan sistem manajemen sesuai dengan kebijakan Perseroan;
c. Melakukan pemeriksaan dan penilaian atas efisiensi dan efektivitas di bidang keuangan, akuntansi, operasional, sumber daya manusia, pemasaran, teknologi informasi dan kegiatan lainnya;

d. Provide suggestions for improvements and objective information regarding the activities examined at all levels of management;
e. Prepare an audit report and submit the report to the President Director, Board of Commissioners, and the Audit Committee;
f. Monitor, analyze and report on the implementation of the suggested improvements;
g. Liaise with the Audit Committee;
h. Develop a program to evaluate the quality of the performance of its internal audit activities;
i. Assist in significant fraud investigations; and
j. Conduct special audit, if needed.

d. Memberikan saran perbaikan dan informasi yang objektif tentang kegiatan yang diperiksa pada semua tingkat manajemen;
e. Membuat laporan hasil audit dan menyampaikan laporan tersebut kepada Presiden Direktur, Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Audit;
f. Memantau, menganalisis dan melaporkan pelaksanaan tindak lanjut perbaikan yang telah disarankan;
g. Bekerja sama dengan Komite Audit;
h. Menyusun program untuk mengevaluasi mutu kegiatan audit internal yang dilakukannya;
i. Membantu dalam penyelidikan dugaan penipuan yang signifikan; dan
j. Melakukan pemeriksaan khusus apabila diperlukan.

# Internal Audit Unit Reporting

## Laporan Unit Audit Internal

Throughout the Year 2025, the Internal Audit Unit carried out general audits based on the annual audit work plan submitted and approved by the Board of Directors. The Internal Audit Unit also conducted special (ad-hoc) audits based on the results of discussions or requests from the management and/or business units.

Sepanjang Tahun 2025, Unit Audit Internal melakukan audit umum berdasarkan rencana kerja audit tahunan yang disampaikan ke dan disetujui oleh Direksi. Unit Audit Internal juga melakukan audit khusus (ad-hoc) berdasarkan hasil pembahasan atau permintaan dari manajemen dan/atau unit bisnis.

The audit plan was prepared using a risk-based approach, where the audit focus is made on areas with high-risk exposure. Further, the audit plan was continuously adjusted based on the changing audit environment and conditions.

Audit results were reported monthly by the Internal Audit Unit to the Board of Directors and the Audit Committee. A summary of audit results and highlights was reported and presented during quarterly meetings with the Board of Commissioners and Audit Committee.

Rencana audit disusun dengan menggunakan pendekatan berbasis risiko, di mana fokus audit dibuat untuk area dengan eksposur risiko yang tinggi. Selanjutnya, rencana audit terus disesuaikan dengan perubahan lingkungan dan kondisi audit.

Hasil audit dilaporkan setiap bulannya oleh Unit Audit Internal kepada Direksi dan Komite Audit. Ringkasan hasil audit dan sorotan telah dilaporkan dan dipresentasikan dalam rapat triwulanan dengan Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Audit.

# Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption Policy

Kebijakan Anti Suap dan Anti Korupsi

The Company has implemented an Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption Policy since January 2014, to comply with the Corruption Eradication Law, and in accordance with the Indonesian Corporate Governance General Guidelines. The Company periodically reviews and updates this policy with revisions made in 2017, 2020, and the most recent update in May 2023.

The Company established the Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption Policy as part of its Good Corporate Governance initiatives, with the following objectives:

1. Create awareness to prevent bribery, corruption, and other unethical conduct that may result in financial or non-financial losses to the Company;
2. Establish clear standards and procedures for reporting and handling suspected violations, including protection mechanisms for whistleblowers against retaliation;
3. Strengthen early detection and mitigation controls through mandatory reporting and review processes; and
4. Promote ethical business conduct and safeguard the Company's integrity and reputation.

This policy complements the Company's Code of Business Ethics and Conduct by providing specific guidance regarding offering receiving and giving items of value that may violate the above regulations, resulting in sanctions and reputational damage to the Company.

In cases of gratification, under certain conditions, including situations where it is impossible/difficult or impractical to refuse a gift/reward, the employee may be allowed to receive such gift/reward from external parties upon the condition that such employee is obliged to report such gift/reward to the relevant parties and the Compliance Division for further review and assessment.

The Company has a whistleblowing system to support reports about possible violations of the above policy which are handled with full anonymity and protection from retaliation.

Throughout the Year 2025, there were some instances of reported receipt of gifts by Company employees, which were consulted to and assessed by our compliance officer. There was no reported instance that violated the above policy.

Perseroan telah menerapkan Kebijakan mengenai Anti-Suap (Anti-Bribery) dan Anti-Korupsi (Anti-Corruption) sejak Januari 2014, yang mana dalam rangka untuk mematuhi Undang-Undang Pemberantasan Tindak Pidana Korupsi, dan sesuai dengan Pedoman Umum Governansi Korporat Indonesia. Perseroan meninjau dan melakukan pengkinian secara berkala sehingga kebijakan tersebut telah mengalami beberapa perubahan pada tahun 2017, 2020, hingga perubahan terakhir pada Mei 2023.

Perseroan menetapkan Kebijakan Anti-Suap dan Anti-Korupsi tersebut sebagai bagian dari inisiatif Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang baik, dengan tujuan sebagai berikut:

1. Menciptakan kesadaran untuk mencegah penyuapan, korupsi, dan perilaku tidak etis lainnya yang dapat mengakibatkan kerugian finansial maupun non-finansial bagi Perseroan;
2. Menetapkan suatu standar dan prosedur yang jelas untuk pelaporan dan penanganan dugaan pelanggaran, termasuk mekanisme perlindungan bagi pelapor dari upaya pembalasan;
3. Memperkuat deteksi dini dan pengendalian mitigasi melalui proses pelaporan dan peninjauan yang wajib; dan
4. Mendorong perilaku bisnis yang etis dan menjaga integritas serta reputasi Perseroan.

Kebijakan ini melengkapi Kode Etik dan Perilaku Bisnis Perseroan dengan memberikan panduan khusus mengenai penerimaan dan pemberian barang bernilai yang dapat melanggar ketentuan di atas, yang dapat mengakibatkan sanksi dan kerusakan reputasi bagi Perseroan.

Dalam hal gratifikasi, pada kondisi tertentu, termasuk situasi dimana tidak memungkinkan/sulit atau tidak praktis untuk menolak hadiah/imbalan, karyawan diperbolehkan menerima hadiah/imbalan tersebut dari pihak eksternal dengan syarat bahwa karyawan tersebut wajib melaporkan pemberian hadiah/imbalan tersebut kepada pihak terkait dan Divisi Kepatuhan untuk peninjauan dan penilaian lebih lanjut.

Perseroan memiliki sistem whistleblowing untuk mendukung laporan mengenai kemungkinan pelanggaran kebijakan di atas yang ditangani dengan anonimitas penuh dan perlindungan dari pembalasan.

Sepanjang Tahun 2025, ada beberapa penerimaan hadiah yang dilaporkan oleh karyawan Perseroan, yang telah dikonsultasikan dan dinilai oleh petugas kepatuhan kami. Dari kasus yang dilaporkan tersebut, tidak ada yang melanggar kebijakan tersebut di atas.

# Scope of Reporting
## Ruang Lingkup Pelaporan

Matters covered by the whistleblowing policy include allegations related to:

- Violation of the Code of Business Ethics and Conduct
- Violation of policies and procedures
- Violation of the law
- Bribery and/or corruption
- Conflict of interest
- Misuse of authority/position
- Fraudulent acts
- Other similar violations that will equate to the above.

Hal-hal yang tercakup dalam kebijakan whistleblowing mencakup dugaan terkait dengan:

- Pelanggaran Kode Etik dan Perilaku Bisnis
- Pelanggaran kebijakan dan prosedur
- Pelanggaran hukum
- Penyuapan dan/atau korupsi
- Benturan kepentingan
- Penyalahgunaan wewenang/jabatan
- Tindakan penipuan
- Pelanggaran serupa lainnya yang dapat disamakan dengan yang ada di atas.

# Handling of Reported Violations
## Penanganan atas Pelanggaran Yang Dilaporkan

Reported cases are received by the compliance officer. The informations are analyzed and investigated for evidence gathering by selected members of the Internal Audit Unit (if necessary).

If necessary, the case will be deliberated by the Ethics Committee. The whistleblower and any relevant party will be informed about the outcome and the action taken.

The Board of Directors and/or the Board of Commissioners are updated on the summary of reports.

Kasus yang dilaporkan diterima oleh petugas kepatuhan. Informasi dianalisis dan diselidiki untuk pengumpulan bukti oleh anggota terpilih dari Unit Internal Audit (jika diperlukan).

Jika perlu, kasus tersebut akan dibahas oleh Komite Etik. Pelapor dan pihak terkait akan diberitahu tentang hasil dan tindakan yang diambil.

Direksi dan/atau Dewan Komisaris akan mendapatkan informasi terbaru tentang ringkasan laporan.

In 2014, the Company issued its Code of Business Ethics and Conduct (the "Code") as part of its drive for Good Corporate Governance. The Code serves as a guidance in all of the Company personnel in dealing with colleagues and external parties and outlines our commitments in the following areas, which include our commitments regarding:

- Protection of Company Assets and Intellectual Property Rights
- Confidential Information and Prohibition of Insider Trading
- Record-keeping and Records Management

- Conflict of Interest
- Receiving Gifts and Hospitalities
- Protection of Personal Data

- Supporting Environmental Sustainability

The above principles are to be strictly adhered to by everyone in the organization. Non-compliance to the above commitments would have corresponding sanction/s.

All new employees go through an induction process/program that includes training to familiarize new employees with the Company's core values. This training is reinforced by an annual mandatory online learning and ad-hoc classroom training or refresher about the Code via an online platform.

## Manajemen Risiko

In supervising and managing material business risks, in Year 2018 the Company established procedures regarding Risk Management which serves as guidance on how the Company can effectively conduct its process of identifying, analyzing, evaluating, addressing, and monitoring risk.

In addition, Risk Management also aims to ensure that management and all employees have the same perception and understanding of the concept of risk management and raise awareness of the importance of risk management.

Dalam melakukan pengawasan dan pengelolaan risiko bisnis yang material, pada tahun 2018 Perseroan telah menetapkan prosedur tentang Manajemen Risiko yang menjadi pedoman bagaimana Perseroan dapat secara efektif melakukan proses identifikasi, analisis, evaluasi, mengatasi, dan pemantauan risiko.

Selain itu, Manajemen Risiko tersebut juga bertujuan untuk memastikan bahwa manajemen dan seluruh pegawai memiliki persepsi serta pemahaman yang sama mengenai konsep manajemen risiko dan menumbuhkan kesadaran mengenai pentingnya manajemen risiko.

The responsibility for carrying out risk assessments lies with each work unit in the Company (Department/Division). The assessment is documented in a Risk Assessment Form which serves as a risk register for such working unit. Risk assessments are conducted periodically by the working unit which will then be tested and reviewed by the Internal Audit Division at least once every year.

The Company's risk profile and list are reported and reviewed by the Company's management annually or in any instances where there are significant changes.

## Types of Risk and Management Methods
### Jenis Risiko dan Cara Pengelolaannya

The following are the types of risks used by the Company as a benchmark for conducting risk analysis, including:

### a. Operational Risk:

Risks that arise due to insufficient and/or failure of internal processes, human error, system failure, or external problems affecting business activities such as force majeure, natural disasters, fires and others.

### b. Compliance Risk:

Risks caused due to the Company not complying with or not implementing statutory regulations and other applicable provisions.

### c. Strategic Risk:

Risks that arise due to improper strategic determination and implementation, inappropriate decision making, or the Company's lack of responsiveness to external changes.

### d. Reputation Risk:

Risks that arise due to negative publicity on operational activities or negative perceptions of the Company.

Risk assessments are conducted to analyze and estimate the probability and the impact of the identified risk. The result of the assessment will help determine which risks should be prioritized for further action. Risk responses are continuously monitored by the relevant work unit, and if the relevant work unit is not able to reduce the identified risks to a level within the Company's risk appetite, additional measures shall be taken.

The risk scores which are mandatory to be mitigated are medium and high. Risk mitigation measures include identifying options for dealing with risks, assessing those options, preparing a risk treatment plan, implementing the risk treatment plan and carrying out subsequent monitoring.

Tanggung jawab pelaksanaan penilaian risiko berada pada masing-masing unit kerja Perseroan (Departemen/Divisi). Penilaian tersebut didokumentasikan dalam Risk Assessment Form yang akan berfungsi sebagai daftar risiko untuk unit kerja tersebut. Penilaian risiko dilakukan secara berkelanjutan oleh unit kerja yang kemudian diuji serta ditelaah oleh Divisi Internal Audit minimal setiap tahun.

Daftar dan profil risiko Perseroan dilaporkan dan ditinjau oleh manajemen Perseroan setiap tahun atau dalam hal terjadinya perubahan signifikan.

Berikut merupakan jenis-jenis risiko yang digunakan oleh Perseroan sebagai tolak ukur untuk melakukan analisis risiko, antara lain:

### a. Risiko Operasional:

Risiko yang ditimbulkan karena ketidakcukupan dan/atau kegagalan proses internal, kesalahan manusia, kegagalan sistem, atau adanya masalah eksternal yang mempengaruhi kegiatan usaha seperti force majeure, bencana alam, kebakaran dan lain-lain.

### b. Risiko Kepatuhan:

Risiko yang disebabkan karena Perseroan tidak mematuhi atau tidak melaksanakan regulasi perundang-undangan dan ketentuan lain yang berlaku.

### c. Risiko Strategis:

Risiko timbul karena penetapan dan pelaksanaan strategis yang tidak tepat, pengambilan keputusan yang tidak tepat, atau kurang responsifnya Perseroan terhadap perubahan eksternal.

### d. Risiko Reputasi:

Risiko yang timbul karena publikasi negatif terhadap kegiatan operasional atau persepsi negatif terhadap Perseroan.

Penilaian risiko dilakukan untuk menganalisa dan memperkirakan probabilitas serta dampak dari risiko yang teridentifikasi. Hasil penilaian risiko akan membantu menentukan risiko apa saja yang harus diprioritaskan untuk ditindaklanjuti. Tanggapan terhadap risiko dipantau secara terus menerus oleh unit kerja terkait, dan apabila unit kerja tersebut tidak mampu mengurangi risiko yang teridentifikasi ke tingkat yang sesuai dengan toleransi risiko Perseroan, maka langkah-langkah tambahan perlu diambil.

Nilai risiko yang wajib dilakukan mitigasi adalah sedang dan tinggi. Langkah mitigasi risiko meliputi pengidentifikasian opsi untuk menangani risiko, menilai opsi tersebut, menyiapkan rencana perlakuan risiko, mengimplementasikan rencana perlakuan risiko dan melakukan pemantauan selanjutnya.

# Public Accountant

## Akuntan Publik

Public Accountant is an external party supporting the Company in evaluating or auditing the Annual Report in accordance with the Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards. Referring to the Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 9 of 2023 on the Use of Public Accountant Services and Public Accounting Firms in Financial Services Activities, the appointment of a Public Accountant is expected to help Company provide accountable, independent, and fair information and data to the shareholders, regulator, as well as other stakeholders.

Akuntan Publik merupakan organ eksternal yang membantu Perseroan dalam melakukan pemeriksaan atau mengaudit Laporan Keuangan agar sesuai dengan Standar Akuntansi Keuangan yang berlaku di Indonesia. Mengacu pada Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 9 Tahun 2023 tentang Penggunaan Jasa Akuntan Publik dan Kantor Akuntan Publik dalam Kegiatan Jasa Keuangan, maka penunjukan Akuntan Publik ini diharapkan dapat mendorong Perseroan untuk memberikan informasi dan data yang akuntabel, independen, dan wajar kepada pemegang saham, regulator, serta pemangku kepentingan lainnya.

## External Audit Procedures and Audit Standards

### Prosedur Audit Eksternal dan Standar Audit

The audit of the Company's Financial Statement is implemented in accordance with public accountant's professional standards which covers all audit procedures regarded compatible with the Company's condition. The audit process encompasses testing, verifying, and evaluating the Financial Statements, as well as assessing the compliance of its contents with the Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards ("PSAK").

The appointment of a Public Accounting Firm ("KAP") is carried out by taking into account the aspects of independency in terms of personnel, processes and audit results so that the Company's Financial Statements fulfil the principles of transparency and accountability.

As a part of the audit process, the KAP representatives conducted a question-and-answer session regarding the management's statements presented in the Financial Statement. If any mistakes are found in the Financial Statement, the KAP must convey it to the management of the Company. The management is also responsible for approving the KAP's audit worksheets.

Audit Laporan Keuangan Perseroan dilakukan sesuai standar profesional akuntan publik, yang mencakup seluruh prosedur audit yang dianggap sesuai dengan keadaan Perseroan. Audit yang dilakukan meliputi pengujian, pemeriksaan, dan evaluasi terhadap Laporan Keuangan, serta penilaian terhadap kesesuaian isi Laporan Keuangan dengan Standar Akuntansi Keuangan Indonesia ("PSAK").

Penunjukan Kantor Akuntan Publik ("KAP") dilaksanakan dengan memperhatikan aspek independensi dari sisi personil, proses, dan hasil audit sehingga Laporan Keuangan Perseroan memenuhi prinsip transparansi dan akuntabilitas.

Sebagai bagian dari proses audit, perwakilan KAP melakukan sesi tanya jawab mengenai pernyataan manajemen yang disampaikan dalam Laporan Keuangan. Jika terdapat kekeliruan di dalam laporan tersebut, maka KAP wajib menyampaikannya kepada manajemen Perseroan. Manajemen juga bertanggung jawab untuk menyetujui kertas kerja pemeriksa KAP terhadap Perseroan.

# The Policy relating to Protection of Creditor's Rights

Kebijakan tentang Pemenuhan Hak-Hak Kreditur

This policy is related to the fulfillment of creditor's right with the objectives to uphold the fulfillment of creditor's right and preserve the trust given by the creditor to the Company.

Kebijakan ini terkait pemenuhan hak-hak kreditur yang bertujuan untuk menjunjung tinggi pemenuhan hak-hak kreditur dan menjaga kepercayaan yang diberikan kreditur kepada Perseroan.

# The Main Principle of Policy

Prinsip Utama Kebijakan

As a form of the Company's commitment to implementing GCG principles, the Company continuously strives to hold the interest of its creditors in high regards, recognizing their role in improving the Company's working capital capabilities as well as a source of funding for medium-term and long-term investments. By maintaining their trust, the Company ensures sustainable growth and long-term business prospects.

The Company is committed to establishing mutually beneficial relationships with its creditors. The Company fully implements the agreements that have been agreed and signed as long as the agreements do not conflict with applicable laws and regulations.

Therefore, the Company has established the Policy on the Fulfillment of Creditor's Rights which aims to maintain the fulfillment of creditor's rights and maintain the trust given by the creditors to the Company.

Sebagai wujud komitmen Perseroan dalam menerapkan prinsip-prinsip GCG, Perseroan senantiasa berupaya untuk menjunjung tinggi kepentingan para kreditur, mengakui peran mereka dalam mendukung modal kerja Perseroan maupun sebagai sumber pendanaan untuk keperluan investasi jangka menengah dan Panjang. Dengan menjaga kepercayaan mereka, Perseroan memastikan pertumbuhan berkelanjutan dan prospek usaha jangka Panjang.

Perseroan berkomitmen untuk menjalin hubungan yang saling bermanfaat dengan para kreditur. Perseroan sepenuhnya melaksanakan perjanjian yang telah disepakati dan ditandatangani sepanjang perjanjian tersebut tidak bertentangan dengan peraturan dan perundangan yang berlaku.

Oleh karenanya Perseroan telah menyusun Kebijakan tentang Pemenuhan Hak-Hak Kreditur yang bertujuan untuk menjaga terpenuhinya hak-hak kreditur dan menjaga kepercayaan yang diberikan para kreditur terhadap Perseroan.

**Case Status**

**Status Perkara**

SIP has past due receivables owed by Mitra Semeru for the pharmaceutical products supplied by SIP to Mitra Semeru. Mitra Semeru has paid the principal of the receivables to SIP but has not yet settled the default interest on the receivables.

SIP mempunyai piutang yang telah jatuh tempo dan terutang kepada Mitra Semeru atas produk farmasi yang dipasok oleh SIP kepada Mitra Semeru. Mitra Semeru telah melunasi pokok piutang yang dimiliki kepada SIP namun belum membayarkan bunga moratoir atas piutang tersebut.

**Risks Faced by the Company and the Impact on the Company**

**Risiko yang Dihadapi dan Pengaruhnya terhadap Perseroan**

SIP is at risk of not getting a full refund of moratory interest, late payment interest, and additional interest amounting to IDR 6,846,017,853 (six billion eight hundred forty six million seventeen thousand eight hundred and fifty three Rupiah).

**Follow-up**

**Tindak Lanjut**

The judge at the East Jakarta District Court decided that lawsuit from SIP cannot be accepted (Niet Ontvankelijke Verklaard/NO) since PT Mitra Sanitari is not included as the Defendant in the lawsuit.
